Ekegusii: Rika na gokana okonganyigwa kwa abanto ase enchera etari engiya; sanga amo amang'ana obobui.

English: Install security lights around your property to deter burglars.
Kiswahili: Weka taa za usalama kuzunguka mali yako ili kuzuia wezi.
Ekegusii: Iboka chitaya chikomoreka buya ase enibo yao ere buna enchera eyemo yogotanga abaibi.

English: A UN workshop brought together multiple sectors to improve strategies for preventing violent extremism.
Kiswahili: Warsha ya Umoja wa Mataifa ilileta pamoja sekta nyingi ili kuboresha mikakati ya kuzuia itikadi kali za kikatili.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwechinse (UN) mbwaretete amo abanto ao ao korwa eserikari goikerania emeroberio yogotanga obokebago bwogosaria abanto amongo goetera amorokererio amabe.

English: Report illicit activities to help recover stolen assets and support law enforcement
Kiswahili: Ripoti shughuli haramu ili kusaidia kurejesha mali zilizoibiwa na kusaidia utekelezaji wa sheria
Ekegusii: Karwe eripoti gochia abambi gose abasikari igoro yabinto ebibe bigendrete gochia ase abagambi gose abasikari gokonya koirania ebinto biaibetwe buna enhera eyemo yogokongia amachiko gokora emeremo.

English: Emergency settings heighten gender-based violence risks and require specialized prevention and response planning.
Kiswahili: Mipangilio ya dharura huongeza hatari za unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na inahitaji mipango maalum ya kuzuia na kukabiliana na hali hiyo.
Ekegusii: Chingaki chiemebasekano gose obokongu nigo chikogesa ribaga abanto gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare naya ekero abeire neganeirie chinchera chigotanga abanto gokorerwa bobe chaiabeene na emeroberio buna baranyare gokonywa.

English: A public forum in Kakamega enabled citizens to report misconduct directly to officials, strengthening community oversight.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la umma huko Kakamega liliwawezesha raia kuripoti utovu wa nidhamu moja kwa moja kwa maafisa, na hivyo kuimarisha usimamizi wa jamii.
Ekegusii: Omosangerekano obonsi aaria Kakamega okonyire abanainchi komanyia abane gotyaertera monto onde igoro yogokora bobe kwabasikari gochia abanene, naigo yakonya kwororobia gokora emeremo.

English: Don't resist during armed robbery - your safety is more valuable than property.
Kiswahili: Usipinge wakati wa wizi wa kutumia silaha - usalama wako una thamani zaidi kuliko mali.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebibago biobibi bikogosagana tiga kwamererania nabarabwo- obogima bwa nobwengencho kobua enibo.

English: Be cautious of strangers asking to use your phone for 'emergencies'.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wageni wanaokuomba kutumia simu yako kwa 'dharura'.
Ekegusii: Erende nabanto otamanyeti bakogosaba esimi yao baake ase ingana rinde rionsi riomobasekano'.

English: Wildlife predation causes losses. Farmers should construct predator-proof enclosures and use guard animals. Compensation is available for verified cases.
Kiswahili: Uwindaji wa wanyamapori husababisha hasara. Wakulima wanapaswa kujenga vizimba visivyoweza kuwindwa na wanyama waharibifu na kutumia wanyama wa ulinzi. Fidia inapatikana kwa visa vilivyothibitishwa.
Ekegusii: Ogoitwa gwetugo nechingiti chiorosana buna endagera yabo nigo gokoreta asara ase omoremi. Nere buya abaremi koagacha gose kogitera etugo yabo buya gotanga chingiti chiorosana goikera etugo yabo na koyeita bua endagera yabo. Ogoakanwa ase baria etugo yabo yaitetwe nechingiti chiorosana nereo ase baria bagitere etugo yabo buya.

English: EACC highlighted media's role in exposing corruption.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gokorwania abokorekanu (EACC) kiaorokirie buna abariki na gotangasa amangana bare neribaga rigiya kooroki obokorekanu.

English: A police partnership initiative trained young women in self-defense and educated participants on rights and complaint channels.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokobwaterana nabasikari mbwegeretie abangina abasae buna baranyare kwerende korwa emechando na gosomia omosangerekano igoro yoboronge bwabo amo nenchera yokorwa okwemuranganania.

English: "Public notice: DCI has shut down a fraudulent real estate company operating under multiple names in Kiambu. Always perform a search at the Lands Ministry."
Kiswahili: "Taarifa kwa umma: DCI imefunga kampuni ya ulaghai ya mali isiyohamishika inayofanya kazi kwa majina mengi huko Kiambu. Daima fanya utafutaji katika Wizara ya Ardhi."
Ekegusii: "Ogokurera ase bonsi": Omotuki omonene osiekire ekampani yobokengeka ogokora obokengeka bwaye goetera amarieta ao ao aaria Kiambu ekongaina abanto kobaoneria emechi yokomenya operating. Kera engaki rigia komanya obomaene bwebinto binga buna ebio korwa ofosi yamaremo."

English: Ongoing training in Kakamega supports security personnel in staying ahead of evolving violent extremism tactics affecting youth.
Ekegusii: Okwegererigwa gwakogenderera aari Kakamega gwakonyire abarendi borendi gotigara maiso igoro yechiburaburu chiogosaria abasae ebirengererio chiakegeire koba.

English: Government issued directives on firearm use, including shoot‑to‑leg order.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilitoa maagizo kuhusu matumizi ya silaha, ikiwa ni pamoja na amri ya kupigana risasi hadi mguu.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yaruete richiko buna chibunduki chigotumaka, amo nokorasa abanto amagoro.

English: Government launched an initiative to combat illegal firearms trafficking with education and surveillance.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yachagete omoroberio bwogokora ebiasara biechibunduki goetra chisemi na education and buna chikoereranigwa.

English: Training provided to mining sector stakeholders on safe handling of commercial explosives to reduce misuse by terror groups and prevent smuggling.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yametolewa kwa wadau wa sekta ya madini kuhusu utunzaji salama wa vilipuzi vya kibiashara ili kupunguza matumizi mabaya ya vikundi vya kigaidi na kuzuia ulanguzi wa magendo.
Ekegusii: Ekwegerigwa kwarurwe ase baria bakorema amadini na baria bakobwaterana buna bakoiya, kogacha na kobibogoria bakeanie okobitatumia buya na baria abasaria bokoruta chipomu na gotanga oboibi bwebinto ebio.

English: Safe houses and shelters offer secure temporary accommodation for survivors and their children.
Kiswahili: Nyumba na makazi salama hutoa malazi salama ya muda kwa manusura na watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Aase agiya neyomba yokomenya nensemo eyemo yoborendi ase baria bakoreirwe bobe nabana babo.

English: Gang violence rising in Nakuru; report suspicious activity.
Kiswahili: Vurugu za genge la wahalifu zaongezeka Nakuru; ripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka.
Ekegusii: Ogosagananigwa nebikundi biabasaria aaria Nakuru; karue eripoti ase abagambi gose abasikari igoro yebikoru biechitang'utang'u.

English: Keep car doors locked and windows up when driving in high-risk areas.
Kiswahili: Weka milango ya gari imefungwa na madirisha wazi unapoendesha gari katika maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
Ekegusii: Sieka emerangu yerori yao na koyeroki buya ekero okogendia erori yao ase chirori nabanto bare abange gose obosaria bwa igoro.

English: Contact emergency services through: Police (999), DCI (0800 722 203).
Kiswahili: Wasiliana na huduma za dharura kupitia: Polisi (999), DCI (0800 722 203).
Ekegusii: Ikera ogokonywa chingaki chiemebasekano goetera: Porisi (999), Omotuki omonene (0800 722 203).

English: Child marriage harms children's health and future. Communities must report cases and support girls' education.
Kiswahili: Ndoa za utotoni hudhuru afya na mustakabali wa watoto. Jamii lazima ziripoti visa na kuunga mkono elimu ya wasichana.
Ekegusii: Enywomo yabana abake nigo egosaria afia yabana nobogima bwabo bwa motwe. Abanto goika barwe eripoti igoro yobobe obwo na gosira chisemi chiomwana omonyaroka.

English: Teach domestic staff to verify identities before opening gates/doors.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe wafanyakazi wa majumbani kuthibitisha utambulisho wao kabla ya kufungua malango/milango.
Ekegusii: Somia abakori emeremo bao ba nka korigereria buya ebibande bia'bageni nyuma batarabaigoreraebiita gose omorangu.

English: Usifanye maonyesho ya mali thamani kwa umma - weka kwa siri na salama.
Kiswahili: Usifanye maonyesho ya mali thamani kwa umma - weka kwa siri na salama.
Ekegusii: Tobaise kworokia enibo yao ore nero ase abanto- yegache ase obobisi na buya.

English: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.
Kiswahili: Epuka kujenga upya katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Serikali inatoa ardhi mbadala kwa familia zilizoathiriwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga koirorera kwoagacha ase riroba rikoanyoka. Eserikari nkorwa ere emegondo emao ase oyio oo ase chifamilia chianyorirwe nomochando oyio.

English: Terror threats remain high; avoid high‑profile crowded areas.
Kiswahili: Vitisho vya ugaidi vinabaki juu; epuka maeneo yenye msongamano mkubwa.
Ekegusii: Obwoba bogakwa chipomu nigo bore igoro; erende toba ase omosangerekano bwa abanto abange.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre invited public contributions for artificial intelligence solutions to counter online radicalization and self recruitment.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaariganetie ebirengererio korwa abanainchi korigia amachibu igoro yechisemi chia pandia buna enchera eyemo yokorwania obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio goetra eintaneti na na kwerika barabwo abanyene gochia ase obosaria obwo.

English: United Kingdom advisory urges alertness in hotels, malls, and transport hubs and encourages use of counter terrorism guidance.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa Uingereza unahimiza tahadhari katika hoteli, maduka makubwa, na vituo vya usafiri na unahimiza matumizi ya mwongozo wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Abasemia ba United Kingdom basabire abanyene bechinyoma chiokoragera na korara, chiduka chinene chikoonia ebinto ao ao, amo naase chirori chikorinerwa erio koba maiso na kobwatia amachiko ogotanga obokebago.

English: University of Nairobi research shows strong positive link between COP strategies and crime reduction in Machakos SubCounty
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi unaonyesha uhusiano mzuri kati ya mikakati ya COP na upunguzaji wa uhalifu katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Machakos
Ekegusii: Obokongoria bweyunifasiti ya Nairobi Nairobi mbwaorogetie emeroberio yokobwateterana kwabeene gati yomoteneneri omonene bwegasi yabasikari (COP) buna yakeanirie obosaria ase emechie ameke yekaonti ya Machakos

English: A rights group compiled a verified injury registry with photos and medical data to support accountability and prosecution efforts.
Kiswahili: Kundi la haki za binadamu liliandaa sajili ya majeraha iliyothibitishwa yenye picha na data ya kimatibabu ili kusaidia juhudi za uwajibikaji na mashtaka.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kioboronge nkiabegete amo eripoti engikeranu igoro ya baria baumiete amo nechibicha neripoti ya nyagitari yabwate amarieta baria baumiete gosira emeroberio yokobabogoreria egatambokero na kobasoera.

English: Highlight corruption issues in your county and urge leaders to enforce accountability
Kiswahili: Angazia masuala ya ufisadi katika kaunti yako na uwasihi viongozi kutekeleza uwajibikaji
Ekegusii: Teba ebinto ebikorekanu nobokorekanu bore ase ekaonti yao na koboria abarai basugume obotenereri obuya.

English: Toolkit empowering communities to counter violent extremism under the NIWETU multi stakeholder initiative.
Kiswahili: Kifaa cha kuwawezesha jamii kukabiliana na itikadi kali chini ya mpango wa NIWETU unaowashirikisha wadau wengi.
Ekegusii: Egetabu kegosomia abanainchi buna baranyare gokinana nobokebago bwogosaria obongo goetera amasomo amabe inse yomoroberi o'NIWETU omoroberio bwabakoreri ao ao.

English: Use incognito mode on shared devices to avoid saving browsing history.
Kiswahili: Tumia hali fiche kwenye vifaa vilivyoshirikiwa ili kuepuka kuhifadhi historia ya kuvinjari.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogotumia ekombiuta yeintaneti, yebeke tabaisa kogacha eki kware korora gose gosoma ekero gwasiekire eki kware gokora. Renda gotagacha eki ogokora ase ase ekombiuta.

English: Drought requires special management. Provide minerals, reduce herd size early, and conserve water.
Kiswahili: Ukame unahitaji usimamizi maalum. Toa madini, punguza ukubwa wa kundi mapema, na uhifadhi maji.
Ekegusii: Eguragura nego eganitie emeroberio emeikernu korenda amache, gosiarera ebimeri amache, na koa etugo amache okonywa. Karwe amache echichuba, keania obonge bwetugo yao genkioy, na gacha amache.

English: Public informed of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and encouraged to stay vigilant as security heightened.
Kiswahili: Umma umearifiwa kuhusu shambulio la Al-Shabaab huko Garissa na kuhimizwa kuwa macho huku usalama ukiimarishwa.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi bamanyiigwe igoro yebikoreri bia akili bandia Al bia -Shabaab goaka epomu Garissa, na kobaa omoyo gotigara maiso ekiagera oborendi bwagesirwe.

English: "CBK reminds Kenyans that legitimate banks do not conduct promotions via Facebook inboxes. Ignore messages asking for account details to 'activate rewards'."
Kiswahili: "CBK inawakumbusha Wakenya kwamba benki halali hazifanyi matangazo kupitia visanduku vya barua pepe vya Facebook. Puuza jumbe zinazouliza maelezo ya akaunti ili 'kuamsha zawadi'."
Ekegusii: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) nkoinyoria ere abanto ba Kenyan ng'a chibengi boronge tichiri gokinia abakori emeremo babo goetera Facebook. Ombia mang'ana ande onsi akogosaba obae ennamba yao yebengi erio bakobekere ekeegwa gie chibesa."

English: Awareness of corruption's impact builds vigilance and ethical behavior, boosting national security.
Ekegusii: Komanyia abanto igoo yobokengeka ngokong'ia ere koba maiso na gokorera ekeene, na gokong.ia oborendi bwense.

English: Opening of the Anti Terrorism Police Unit Coast Headquarters to strengthen investigations and community engagement.
Ekegusii: Okoigorwa kwegetengo kia abasikari bakinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu aaria omochie omonene O'Mombasa gokong'ia obotuki nokobwaterana nebinyoro.

English: Judiciary introduced a strategic framework to eliminate corruption.
Ekegusii: Ekoti yaansire omoroberio ebeene gokora obokorekanu.

English: Editorial commentary advocated reforms to the Public Order Act to safeguard peaceful assembly and curb excessive force.
Ekegusii: Amanga ya abange buna barwete ebirengererio biabo gosegeta oboonchoreria ase richiko ritenenerete buna abanto baukoumerana ase obonge na korobererekana erio korenda ogocha amo nokorobererekana kwomorembe igo gotanga abasikari gotumia chinguru chinyinge.

English: Report child labor, forced marriage, and abuse to relevant authorities or hotlines.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ajira ya watoto, ndoa ya kulazimishwa, na unyanyasaji kwa mamlaka husika au simu za dharura.
Ekegusii: Manyia abagambi bebinyoro gose abasikari otari konyorwa igoro yobosomba bwabana, enywomo yabana, gotibongwa gose gokorerwa bobe goetera enamba yesimi yamorero.

English: Support youth engagement and integrity clubs in local events to prevent corruption.
Kiswahili: Saidia vilabu vya ushirikishwaji na uadilifu wa vijana katika matukio ya ndani ili kuzuia rushwa.
Ekegusii: Konya abasae ase gokwanerana na gosoa ebiombe biogotenera ekeene ase emeyega yebinyoro buna enhera eyemo yotanga obokengeka.

English: Report any unethical conduct in your community to protect public resources and strengthen institutions
Kiswahili: Ripoti mwenendo wowote usio wa kimaadili katika jamii yako ili kulinda rasilimali za umma na kuimarisha taasisi
Ekegusii: Karwe eripoti igoro yebinto ebibe bigenderete ase ekenyoro kiao erio korenda enibo yekenyoro na gokongia obokoreri.

English: Businesses must avoid employing children and support initiatives for their education instead.
Kiswahili: Biashara lazima ziepuke kuajiri watoto na badala yake ziunge mkono mipango ya elimu yao.
Ekegusii: Abanyabiasara goika barende tibarika abana buna abkori emeremo yabo korende basire emeroberio yogokonya ng'a bachire esukuru gosoma.

English: A curfew was imposed in Mandera County to address rising insecurity and facilitate ongoing security operations.
Kiswahili: Amri ya kutotoka nje iliwekwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera ili kukabiliana na ongezeko la ukosefu wa usalama na kurahisisha shughuli za usalama zinazoendelea.
Ekegusii: Ogochika gotanga abanto mbasoka korwa chinka chiabo chinsa gete nkwabegetwe aaria ekaonti ya Mandera buna enchera eyemo yogokeania obokebago na kobeka oborendi ase omoroberio bwokogenderera.

English: Use technology and social media to participate in anti-corruption campaigns.
Kiswahili: Tumia teknolojia na mitandao ya kijamii kushiriki katika kampeni za kupambana na ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Tumia tekinorochia nebiombo biokomanyia amang'ana erio korwa ebirengererio biao ase ogokinana nobokorekanu.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre and Operation Amani Boni conducted community workshops in Lamu County that focused on awareness, intelligence sharing, and resilience building.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) orogetwe "Amani Boni" nokorete emesangererekano aaria ekaonti ya Lamu yamoregete omokanyia abanto, koererania amang'ana obotuki, na kobakong'ia.

English: Use community platforms to educate on disaster preparedness, emergency numbers, and safety protocols
Kiswahili: Tumia majukwaa ya jamii kuelimisha kuhusu maandalizi ya maafa, nambari za dharura, na itifaki za usalama
Ekegusii: Tumia emesangerekano yebinyoro komanyia na gosomia abanto buna baranyare kwerenda korwa emechando, chinamba chiesimi korangeria ogokonywa, namachiko oborendi.

English: Neighbors, teachers, and relatives must speak up against child abuse to create safer environments for children.
Kiswahili: Majirani, walimu, na jamaa lazima wazungumze dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa watoto ili kuunda mazingira salama kwa watoto.
Ekegusii: Abaamate,abarimu, na abairi goika bakwenere ringana igoro yabana gokorerwa bobe erio korora ng'a abana tibari ase hatari yogokorerwa bobe.

English: Authorities issued detailed Cyclone Hidaya safety guidance urging coastal residents to secure property and avoid non-essential travel.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka yalitoa mwongozo wa kina wa usalama wa Kimbunga Hidaya kikiwataka wakazi wa pwani kulinda mali na kuepuka usafiri usio wa lazima.
Ekegusii: Abari mbwaretwe oborai boisaine igoro yomorindo okorokwa (Cyclone Hidaya) sna gosaba amenyi bonsi bamenyete ang'e na nyancha barende chinibo chiabo na gokeania chisafari chitari chiengencho.

English: Check for 'https://' and a padlock icon before entering payment details online.
Kiswahili: Angalia 'https://' na aikoni ya kufuli kabla ya kuingiza maelezo ya malipo mtandaoni.
Ekegusii: Rigereria 'https://' amo nekeogorero kiaye nyuma otarabeka gose goskana chisebesa goetera eintaneti.

English: Verify identity of delivery personnel before allowing access to property.
Kiswahili: Thibitisha utambulisho wa wafanyakazi wa usafirishaji kabla ya kuruhusu ufikiaji wa mali.
Ekegusii: Rigereria buya ekabande kiomonto ogokoba gose korenta ebinto buya nyuma otaramwanchera gosoa.

English: Residents in flood and conflict‑prone areas ordered to evacuate with routes and shelters listed.
Kiswahili: Wakazi katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na mafuriko na migogoro wameamriwa kuhama huku njia na makazi yakiorodheshwa.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi bari bare aase emegoko gose aregire chimanano bachikirwe kong'anya korwa ase ande onsi ararete emechando gochia ase atebire neserikari gose chinyomba chiria eserikariyatebire.

English: US government advised citizens to avoid Eastleigh and Kibera due to security concerns.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Marekani iliwashauri raia kuepuka Eastleigh na Kibera kutokana na wasiwasi wa usalama.
Ekegusii: Eserikari ya America yasemirie abanainchi koba maiso gochia Eastleigh na Kibera ase engencho yoborendi botari oboikeranu.

English: Foster caregivers must be vetted to ensure safe environments for vulnerable children.
Kiswahili: Walezi wa watoto wa kulea lazima wachunguzwe ili kuhakikisha mazingira salama kwa watoto walio katika mazingira magumu.
Ekegusii: Abaibori abarendi babana barigererigwa buya bataraegwa abana korenda erio korenda nga abana baria abake batanyare kwerenda.

English: DusitD2 attack underscores importance of knowing emergency exits and procedures in hotels and office buildings.
Kiswahili: Shambulio la DusitD2 linasisitiza umuhimu wa kujua njia za kutokea na taratibu za dharura katika hoteli na majengo ya ofisi.
Ekegusii: Ogoakwa epomu gwa DusitD2 nogokurera ng'a komanya bwango na gotanga obokebago nechinchera chiokominchoreria nemeroberio yonsi ase chinyomba chiokoragerera nechiofisi eikaranigwe.

English: Use security cameras with cloud storage to preserve evidence if needed.
Kiswahili: Tumia kamera za usalama zenye hifadhi ya wingu ili kuhifadhi ushahidi inapohitajika.
Ekegusii: Beka chikamera chiria chibwatanirie neintaneti chikobwata abanto buna bagosoa na gosoka gose ebinto bigendererete kogonya obosaiti ekero boganeirie.

English: Rise in robberies and unrest during protests calls for vigilance.
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa wizi na machafuko wakati wa maandamano kunahitaji uangalifu.
Ekegusii: Okogeseka kwoboibi nechiminano chingaki chiokorobererekana neringana rigneti korigerigwa ase obongaini.

English: Human trafficking for sexual exploitation is a serious crime. National laws provide strong penalties and survivor protections.
Kiswahili: Usafirishaji haramu wa binadamu kwa ajili ya unyonyaji wa kingono ni uhalifu mkubwa. Sheria za kitaifa hutoa adhabu kali na ulinzi kwa walionusurika.
Ekegusii: Enchera yokobetereria gose koira abanto ase egete ase engencho yokobaonia ase ebiasara biobwanchani konyora chibesa okomocha okobe mono. Amachiko yense nkorwa are egesusuro ekerito na gokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe.

English: Several Kenyans have reported scam calls claiming to be from international couriers requesting customs clearance payments. Confirm such calls with KRA or the courier directly
Kiswahili: Wakenya kadhaa wameripoti simu za ulaghai zinazodaiwa kutoka kwa wasafirishaji wa kimataifa wanaoomba malipo ya kibali cha forodha. Thibitisha simu hizo moja kwa moja na KRA au msafirishaji.
Ekegusii: Abakenya abange banyorire chisimi korwa ebobagp bikobasaba chibesa gose kobaa amanga igoro yabo korwa abakweroka buna baria bagokora emeremo yobobogoria emesigo korwa chinse chia isiko mbare nomosigo oo abae chibesa chiogoetia omoesigo iyio erio bagokonye. Koranyore esimi yengencho etye manyia office chia chiebango (KRA) gose ekambani eyio bakogotebi.

English: Advisories highlight persistent al Shabaab threats and urge high situational awareness.
Kiswahili: Ushauri unaangazia vitisho vinavyoendelea vya al Shabaab na kuhimiza uelewa wa hali ya juu.
Ekegusii: Abasemia bamanyirie igoro yokonyarekana kwa al Shabaab kogenderera koruta chipomu na gosaba ng'a abanto babe maiso komanya eki barengete.

English: Analysis identifies persistent terrorist activity in counties bordering Somalia and urges adherence to safety recommendations.
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi unabainisha shughuli za kigaidi zinazoendelea katika kaunti zinazopakana na Somalia na unahimiza uzingatiaji wa mapendekezo ya usalama.
Ekegusii: Obokongori bwaorokirie igoro yokogenderera kwobkebago bwokuruta chipomu ase chikaonti chiria chibebekaine na Somalia na gosaba ng'a okobwatia amachiko oborendi buna ring'ana riengencho.

English: Reuters confirmed the arrest of Constable Mukhwana over the death of blogger Albert Ojwang, marking a rare formal charge amid unrest.
Kiswahili: Reuters ilithibitisha kukamatwa kwa Konstebo Mukhwana kutokana na kifo cha mwanablogu Albert Ojwang, na kuashiria shtaka rasmi ambalo ni nadra kutokea wakati wa machafuko.
Ekegusii: Abarimi amang'ana ba Reuters mbaenegetie okobwatwa kwomosikari Mukhwana igoro yamakweri yomoriki amangana bwogwetenenera Albert Ojwang, eke nigo kiabete egento getanyagokoreka rinde, na konyorwa nare nekina giokoiraneria nonya chuburaburu chiareo.

English: Kenya's cybersecurity strategy to protect critical information infrastructure and enhance public online safety.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa usalama wa mtandao wa Kenya kulinda miundombinu muhimu ya taarifa na kuimarisha usalama wa umma mtandaoni.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio o'Kenya korenda chisimi nechikombiuta tichitumeka bobe erio korenda amang'ana tasoa amaboko amabe buna enchera eyemo yogoikerania oborendi bweintaneti.

English: Save critical numbers: *719# for Red Cross, 999 for police, and 112 for ambulance services during disasters. Share with family and neighbors.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi nambari muhimu: *719# kwa Msalaba Mwekundu, 999 kwa polisi, na 112 kwa huduma za ambulensi wakati wa majanga. Shiriki na familia na majirani.
Ekegusii: Kabe nechinamba chikorigia ogokonya:*719# ase ekeombe kiomosaraba omobariri,999 asee porisi na 112 ase chorori chiria chiogokonya ekero kiomochando.Manyania chinamba echi nabanto baino na abaamate.

English: An audit exposed misuse of public funds in police operations and prompted calls for fiscal transparency and procurement reform.
Kiswahili: Ukaguzi ulifichua matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma katika shughuli za polisi na kusababisha wito wa uwazi wa kifedha na mageuzi ya ununuzi.
Ekegusii: Obokongoria mbwaorokia maiso marore igoro yogotumia chibesa bobe ekero abasikari bagokora emesako ekio kiagerete abanto gotaka komanya obokeene na obomaiso marore ase ogotumia chibesa echio na amaochorerio yobogori.

English: Keep walkways clear of obstacles to prevent trips and falls.
Kiswahili: Weka njia za kutembea mbali na vikwazo ili kuzuia matembezi na kuanguka.
Ekegusii: Rusia kegocha kende giosni ase abanto baogoetera gokonya abanto mbagochwa na kogwa.

English: Explain legal rights when arrested to the public.
Kiswahili: Eleza haki za kisheria unapokamatwa kwa umma.
Ekegusii: Manyia abanto oboronge bwao bwamachiko ekero kwabwatirwe nabanto.

English: Disaster preparedness reduces losses. Identify evacuation routes and store emergency supplies.
Kiswahili: Utayari wa maafa hupunguza hasara. Tambua njia za uokoaji na uhifadhi vifaa vya dharura.
Ekegusii: Kweroberia buya nyuma yemechando nigo ogotanga asara. Orokia chinchera chiokominchoreria ekero kiemebasekano na gacha endagera orarie ekero kiemebasekano.

English: Coastal communities should recognize tsunami warning signs (receding water) and move to higher ground immediately.
Kiswahili: Jamii za pwani zinapaswa kutambua ishara za onyo la tsunami (maji yanapungua) na kuhamia kwenye ardhi ya juu mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baonchokanete enyancha nere buya babe nobomanyi bwokomanya ekero omwaga omonene bwesunami okare gocha (obwango bwa amache enyancha agocha na kogenda)erio batame gochia ase aimokerete igoro bwango kegima.

English: Those job ads for 'NGO agents hiring enumerators' without an interview are a scam. Verify with the actual NGO before sending money."
Kiswahili: Matangazo hayo ya kazi kwa 'mawakala wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wanaoajiri wahesabuji' bila mahojiano ni ulaghai. Thibitisha na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kabla ya kutuma pesa.
Ekegusii: Amangana ogosegeta korwa abaagenti ba'NGO ng'a nkorika bare abanto bakorika amang'ana gotakorigwa ogotemwa kwemeremo namangana oborimo. Manya boronge ng'a NGO ki yatomete amang'ana ayio."

English: Engage in local initiatives to support global anti-corruption efforts and treaties.
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika mipango ya ndani ili kuunga mkono juhudi na mikataba ya kimataifa ya kupambana na ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Bwaterana nemeroberio yanka gosira ense engima korwania obokorekanu namachiko aye.

English: If you are looking for customer support, use the numbers on the company's website.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unatafuta huduma kwa wateja, tumia nambari zilizo kwenye tovuti ya kampuni.
Ekegusii: Onye gokorigia ogokonywa korwa ekambani, tumia chinamba chiesimi gose eintaneti yekambani.

English: Garissa schools receive armed protection after attack.
Kiswahili: Shule za Garissa hupokea ulinzi wa silaha baada ya shambulio.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru chia Garissa chianyore oborendi korwa abasikari babwate chibunduki nyuma yogosaganwa.

English: Reports on campaigns building trust and intelligence sharing with communities.
Kiswahili: Ripoti kuhusu kampeni zinazojenga uaminifu na ushiriki wa akili na jamii.
Ekegusii: Nkomanyia bare igoro yechinkwana chigosegeta gokina okwegenana na koererania amang'ana obotuki nabanyabinyoro.

English: Teach children how to call for help in emergencies (999 or 112).
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto jinsi ya kupiga simu kuomba msaada katika dharura (999 au 112).
Ekegusii: Somia abana bamanye buna baranyare krigia ogokonya ekero kiemebasekano goetera (999 gose 112).

English: Kenya and the U.S. signed a partnership to strengthen border surveillance, intelligence sharing, and law-enforcement training.
Ekegusii: Kenya amo neserikari ya America baigwanire kobwaterana erio gokong'ia obomongeri bwechinsinyo chiato, koererania obutuki, na amasomo buna amachiko agokora emeremo.

English: Participate in national celebrations or campaigns that emphasize ethics and integrity
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika sherehe au kampeni za kitaifa zinazosisitiza maadili na uadilifu
Ekegusii: Ikerana ase amatuko amanene yemeyega yeserikari gose chinkwana egokwanera igoro yekeene.

English: Refugee camps must prioritize safety planning, adequate lighting, and women's participation in governance.
Kiswahili: Kambi za wakimbizi lazima zitoe kipaumbele katika kupanga usalama, taa za kutosha, na ushiriki wa wanawake katika utawala.
Ekegusii: Aaria chikambi chia baria batamire chisegi korwa chinsobo goika baroberie igoro yoborendi, oborabu boisaine ase chikambi chiabo, na gosangia abangina ase emeroberio yoborendi bwabo.

English: Judicial leadership endorsed IPOA's mandate and pledged support for stronger cooperation between the judiciary and the oversight body.
Kiswahili: Uongozi wa mahakama uliidhinisha agizo la IPOA na kuahidi kuunga mkono ushirikiano imara zaidi kati ya mahakama na chombo cha usimamizi.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri bokogamba ebina mbaete okoboko ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) buna kegokora emeremo na koenekia kobasira ase okobwaterana gti yechikoti nebiombe biria bikomongera obokoreri bwabo.

English: Canada advises high vigilance across Kenya due to ongoing extremist threats and warns against large gatherings.
Kiswahili: Kanada inashauri kuwa makini kote Kenya kutokana na vitisho vinavyoendelea vya itikadi kali na inaonya dhidi ya mikusanyiko mikubwa.
Ekegusii: Canada yarure obosemia koba maiso Kenya engima ase engencho ykogosia okwo kogendererete jkwogoakwa chipomu na gosaba nga abanto tibaba ase emesagerekano ybanto abange amo.

English: Showcase success stories of refugees integrating into Kenyan communities.
Kiswahili: Onyesha hadithi za mafanikio za wakimbizi waliojiunga na jamii za Kenya.
Ekegusii: Manyia igoro yokogenderera kwa baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo komenya buna Abakenya.

English: "The Ministry of ICT reminds citizens that all eCitizen payments are automated. Do not send money to personal numbers for services."
Kiswahili: "Wizara ya TEHAMA inawakumbusha raia kwamba malipo yote ya kielektroniki ni otomatiki. Usitume pesa kwa nambari za kibinafsi kwa huduma."
Ekegusii: "Eminisitiri yamang'ana netekinorochi yokoererania amang'ana (ICT)nkoinyoria ere abanainchi chibesa chionsi chia eCitizen nigo chigoakanwa goetera ebengi na Mpesa chimanyekanete neserikari . Tiga gotoma chibesa gochia chinamba chabanto nonya ngake."

English: Law Society demanded accountability for commanders behind protest suppression tactics, calling for prosecutions including chain-of-command responsibility.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Wanasheria kilidai uwajibikaji kwa makamanda waliohusika na mbinu za kukandamiza maandamano, wakitaka mashtaka yafunguliwe ikiwemo jukumu la mnyororo wa amri.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia amachiko (Law Society) nkiaboretie ng'a abanene babasikari baria bare korwa amachiko chingaki chiokorobererekana babogorerigwe ebitambokero, na gosaba ng'a abanene babasikari amo na baria baete richiko kobuna amachiko basoerwe.

English: Do not use damaged or burning electrical appliances.
Kiswahili: Usitumie vifaa vya umeme vilivyoharibika au vinavyoungua.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotumia ebinto biesitima bisaregete gose bigisamba.

English: Local communities should establish child protection committees to monitor and report abuse cases, working closely with government agencies.
Kiswahili: Jamii za wenyeji zinapaswa kuanzisha kamati za ulinzi wa watoto ili kufuatilia na kuripoti kesi za unyanyasaji, zikifanya kazi kwa karibu na mashirika ya serikali.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ebinyoro koba nechikomiti igoro yoborendi bwa abana chikomongera na koripoti buna abana kogorerwa bobe, gokora emeremo yabo ase ase okobwaterana nebiombe bieserikari.

English: NCTC led a national dialogue addressing youth vulnerabilities exploited by extremist groups and promoting multi-stakeholder resilience.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaraete chinkwana chiense gokwanera buna obogongeru bwabasae bogotumeka nabibago biria bigosaria amongo abo na gosegeta okobwaterana korwa chinsemo ao ao.

English: We urge citizens to continue volunteering information that will lead to the arrest of Francis Gaitho.
Kiswahili: Tunawasihi raia kuendelea kutoa taarifa za kujitolea zitakazopelekea kukamatwa kwa Francis Gaitho.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosaba abanainchi bagenderere korwa amang'ana gochia ase abasikari aranyare gokonya komobwata Francis Gaitho.

English: Kenya increased budgets for oversight bodies in FY2025/26.
Kiswahili: Kenya iliongeza bajeti kwa mashirika ya usimamizi katika mwaka wa fedha wa 2025/26.
Ekegusii: Kenya yagesete ekerengo giechibesa chiogokora emeremo ase ebiombe biria bikomongera obokoreri ase omwaka bwechibes 2025/26.

English: Use easy-opening windows in bedrooms for emergencies.
Kiswahili: Tumia madirisha yanayofunguka kwa urahisi katika vyumba vya kulala kwa dharura.
Ekegusii: Beka chitirisa chikoigoka kebwororo ase chinyomba chiokorara koba aororo ekero kiemebasekano kominchoria.

English: Transform street children's lives through shelter programs.
Kiswahili: Badilisha maisha ya watoto wa mitaani kupitia programu za makazi.
Ekegusii: Onchoreria obogima bwa abana bamenyete ebisona ase chitaoni ase okobaa oboraro nechinchera chiokobaonchoreria gochia obogime obuya.

English: Older women experience specific forms of abuse. Caregiver training supports prevention and protection.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wazee hupata aina maalum za unyanyasaji. Mafunzo ya walezi husaidia kuzuia na kulinda.
Ekegusii: Abangina abagotu nigo bagokorerwa bobe enchera ching'ao. Egeria baria babarendete buna enchera eyemo yogotanga gokorerwa bobe na kobarenda.

English: Raise awareness about the gender pay gap in corporate Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa kuhusu pengo la malipo ya kijinsia katika makampuni ya Kenya.
Ekegusii: Manyia abanto igoro gotareng'anana ase emesaara gati ya banto bechingencho chionsi ase Kenya yaito eye ere mberogoikera amagenderero.

English: All public health facilities in Kenya offer free medical services for gender-based violence survivors.
Kiswahili: Vituo vyote vya afya vya umma nchini Kenya hutoa huduma za matibabu bila malipo kwa waathiriwa wa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.
Ekegusii: Chinyagitari chionsi chieserikari aiga nka Kenya nkorwa chire obobwenia ao ao bogokorerwa bobe bosa ase baria bamocheirwe.

English: Security agencies increased nationwide patrols during the festive season to deter crime and safeguard communities.
Kiswahili: Mashirika ya usalama yaliongeza doria za kitaifa wakati wa msimu wa sikukuu ili kuzuia uhalifu na kulinda jamii.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri boborendi bagesire obomongeri bwabo Kenya engima chingaki chiotimoko nemeyega ao ao gotanga obokebago eri korenda ebinyoro.

English: NPS published a Text detailing roles and expectations of community policing in Nairobi County
Kiswahili: NPS ilichapisha Nakala inayoelezea majukumu na matarajio ya polisi jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene ki'abasikari nkiarigete amangana ameng'e agoteba buya emeremo na egekageire korwa abarendi boborndi bwebinyo ase ekaonti ya Nairobi.

English: Encrypt sensitive files before sharing them online.
Kiswahili: Simba faili nyeti kabla ya kuzishiriki mtandaoni.
Ekegusii: Amanagana ao obobisi yakeborane gochia enkwana yobobisi otayarasanga ase eintaneti.

English: Authorities warned Western and Nyanza communities of suspected terror recruitment and urged reporting of suspicious behavior.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka zilionya jamii za Magharibi na Nyanza kuhusu tuhuma za kuajiri watu wanaoshukiwa kuwa magaidi na kuhimiza kuripotiwa kwa tabia zinazoshukiwa.
Ekegusii: Aabarai mbakurerete ebinyoro bia Mocha na Nyanza igoro yogosoigwa ase obokebago bwogoaka chipomu na gosororwa komanyia abagambi igoro ya kende gionsi giechitang'utang'u.

English: Over thirty thousand Kenya Prison Service staff received training on detecting and mitigating violent extremism within correctional facilities.
Ekegusii: Goetania abasikari 30,000 bechera mbanyorete amasomo buna bakiomanya na gotanga ogosarigwa obongo koba ekebago giokoruta chipomu ime ase chichera.

English: APS introduced a yellow card system allowing citizens to report misconduct anonymously during patrols.
Kiswahili: APS ilianzisha mfumo wa kadi za njano unaowaruhusu raia kuripoti utovu wa nidhamu bila kujulikana wakati wa doria.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gis abasikari bobokoreri (APS) mnkiarwete ekadi yerangi yomochununu buna enchera yogokonya abanainchi komanyia amamocho abasikari bagokora gotemanyekania naye ng'o chingaki bagora omosako.

English: Women in politics face violence aimed at limiting participation. Electoral laws protect candidates and voters from gender-based harm.
Kiswahili: Wanawake katika siasa wanakabiliwa na vurugu zinazolenga kupunguza ushiriki. Sheria za uchaguzi huwalinda wagombea na wapiga kura kutokana na madhara yanayotokana na jinsia.
Ekegusii: Obakungu bagokora siasa nigo bagokorerwa bobe korengete gokeania esiasa yabo gochia ase abasqacha. Amachiko obochori nkorenda are abarigia chikura nabaaki chikura korwa gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare.

English: Promote integrity and transparency in all institutions. Together, we can prevent corruption before it starts.
Kiswahili: Kukuza uadilifu na uwazi katika taasisi zote. Kwa pamoja, tunaweza kuzuia ufisadi kabla haujaanza.
Ekegusii: Segeta ekeene nobomaiso marore ase chinsemo chionsi chiobokoreri. Ase oboamo, nabo togotanga obokorekanu tiboba.

English: Maintain safe following distances while driving.
Kiswahili: Dumisha usalama wa kufuata umbali unapoendesha gari.
Ekegusii: Karwe ribaga risaine kore epara korundia erori are korwa erori ere motwe.

English: Use a strong password like 'Nairobi2023!/' that is not easy to crack.
Kiswahili: Tumia nenosiri kali kama 'Nairobi2023!/' ambalo si rahisi kulifungua.
Ekegusii: Tumia enomba yesiri enkongu okoigorera esimi yao buna Gusii2025! Eyio etari raisi ase monto onde koigora.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre worked with the Ministry of Basic Education to train teachers on identifying and mitigating radicalization risks in schools.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kilifanya kazi na Wizara ya Elimu ya Msingi kutoa mafunzo kwa walimu kuhusu kutambua na kupunguza hatari za itikadi kali shuleni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) kegakora emeremo amo neminisitiri yechisemi chioboroso gosomia abarimu buna bakomanya na gotanga obobe bwiogosarigwa ebirengererio chisukuru.

English: Parliament strengthens anti money laundering and counter terrorism financing frameworks.
Kiswahili: Bunge laimarisha mifumo ya kupambana na utakatishaji fedha haramu na kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Bunge yakongirie okorosia chipesa chia pandia na gokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu na baria bakobaa chibesa gokora obokebago obwo.

English: The Guardian covered the arrest of a constable linked to a political blogger's death in custody, seen as a rare step toward accountability.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Guardian liliripoti kukamatwa kwa polisi aliyehusishwa na kifo cha mwanablogu wa kisiasa akiwa kizuizini, jambo linaloonekana kama hatua adimu kuelekea uwajibikaji.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba The Guardian mbarigete igoro yokobwatwa kwomosikari oyio otumegete gesiasa na komobwata kwomoriki amangana bwetenenerete oyio okerete eseri ya polisi buna enchera eyemo ekworokia buna abasikari babweneret goajibika.

English: "The Judiciary has received complaints about fake court summons sent via email. Summons are never delivered electronically or through WhatsApp
Kiswahili: "Mahakama imepokea malalamiko kuhusu wito bandia wa mahakama unaotumwa kupitia barua pepe. Wito haujawasilishwa kielektroniki au kupitia WhatsApp."
Ekegusii: "EkKoti yanyorire okwemurunganania okonge igoro yokorangerigwa kwa abanto baike kotini ase enchera yoborimo goetera eintaneti. Amangana yokorangerigwa goika kotini tari gotomwa goetera eintaneti gose goetera Whatsapp.

English: Teach children fire safety measures and ensure homes have working smoke detectors to prevent tragedies.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto hatua za usalama wa moto na hakikisha nyumba zina vifaa vya kugundua moshi vinavyofanya kazi ili kuzuia majanga.
Ekegusii: Somia abana chinhera chiokwerenda nomorero na rora ng'a chinka chibwate egento keria gekomanya ekero erioki rireo erio gokonya gotanga emerero gwateka.

English: Always have a working flashlight and extra batteries at home.
Kiswahili: Daima uwe na tochi inayofanya kazi na betri za ziada nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki tema koba netochi inka orayare gwokia ekero esitima yagendire amao nasasi ande oranyare koyebeka ekro aria are ime aerire.

English: UK urges vigilance due to terrorism and public order risks.
Kiswahili: Uingereza yahimiza tahadhari kutokana na hatari za ugaidi na utulivu wa umma.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa Bongeresa (UK) bwasabire koba maiso ase engencho yobokebago bwokoruta chipomu naboigo hatari ase abanainchi.

English: "DCI warns against conmen selling fake 'church land' in Kayole and Ruai. Verify ownership documents at the Ministry of Lands before making any payment."
Kiswahili: "DCI yaonya dhidi ya matapeli wanaouza 'ardhi bandia ya kanisa' huko Kayole na Ruai. Thibitisha hati za umiliki katika Wizara ya Ardhi kabla ya kufanya malipo yoyote."
Ekegusii: "Omotuki omonene orure ogokurera gochia abangainereria baria bakkonia amaremo echikanisa ataiyo aari kayole na Ruai. Manya buya abanyene oboremo ase ofisi chia amaremo otaraakana besa chinde chionsi."

English: Stray animals destroy property. Maintain secure fencing and report damage promptly.
Kiswahili: Wanyama waliopotea huharibu mali. Dumisha uzio imara na uripoti uharibifu haraka.
Ekegusii: Etugo yabagoire nigo egosari ebimeri biabanto. Gitera buya etugo yao na manyia abanyene ekero etugo yao yasaririe ebinto bia bande.

English: Suspected child abuse should be reported immediately to police or through the *116# anonymous helpline.
Kiswahili: Unyanyasaji unaoshukiwa kwa watoto unapaswa kuripotiwa mara moja kwa polisi au kupitia simu ya usaidizi ya *116# isiyojulikana.
Ekegusii: Abana ekageire gokorerwa bobe gose gotibongwa goika eripoti erugwe gotachererwa gochia ase abasikari goetera enamba eye yesimi *116# otari kwemanyekania.

English: UNODC and the National Counter Terrorism Centre are training officials to improve detection of terrorism financing.
Ekegusii: Office enene yense etenerete omariogo nobosaria (UNODC) amo na ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkwegeria bare abakori emeremo babo gokongia obomongeria igoro ya baria bakoa ebibago chibesa chigokora obokebago vbwokoruta chipomu.

English: Free fire safety training is available for communities to prevent and respond to fire outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya usalama wa moto bila malipo yanapatikana kwa jamii ili kuzuia na kukabiliana na milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Amasomo abosa igoro yokwerenda ekero kiomorero nareo ase ebinyoro gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka.

English: Put emergency contacts in your phone: Police (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
Kiswahili: Weka anwani za dharura kwenye simu yako: Polisi (999), Ambulensi (911), Zimamoto (990).
Ekegusii: Bechaka chinamba chiemebasekano ime ase esimi yao: Porisi (999), Egari yemebasekano (911), Omorero bwatekire (990).

English: Transport Department launched a risk prevention plan to improve transparency.
Ekegusii: Ensemo yobobogoria yaansete emeroberio yogotanga emebasekano yechipara buna enchera eyemo goyoikerania obomaiso marore.

English: An NGO launched a citizen oversight toolkit with training materials and reporting templates to strengthen youth involvement in accountability.
Kiswahili: Shirika lisilo la kiserikali lilizindua zana ya usimamizi wa raia yenye vifaa vya mafunzo na vielelezo vya kuripoti ili kuimarisha ushiriki wa vijana katika uwajibikaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gie NGO yarwete egetabu kiomoroberio bwo'bomongeri bwabainchi nebinto bwokwegeria na buna babwenerete korwa amang'ana gochia erio gokongia abasae komanya na gotenerera ebikoru biabo.

English: Use security bars or grilles on vulnerable windows and doors.
Kiswahili: Tumia baa za usalama au grille kwenye madirisha na milango iliyo hatarini.
Ekegusii: Sambereria egiriri ase chitirisa nemerangu gochikong'ia.

English: Hilly areas like Murang'a are prone to landslides. Avoid building on steep slopes and heed evacuation warnings during heavy rains.
Kiswahili: Maeneo yenye vilima kama Murang'a yanakabiliwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Epuka kujenga kwenye miteremko mikali na zingatia maonyo ya uokoaji wakati wa mvua kubwa.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chimogete iguru buna Murang'a naororo konyora okwanyoka kweriroba.Kabe are nechinyomba chiagachire ase aimogete igoro naende igwera chinchera chigokurera ekero kiembura enene.

English: An analysis assessed police tactics used during mass demonstrations, focusing on proportionality, arrests, and rights-based policing.
Ekegusii: Amasomo abeene igoro yabasikari nkworokia kore buna abasikari bakoererania ekerogo korobererekana, bagotumia chinguru koreng'ana nobonge bwabanto, nagoetera enchera yekemwanyabanto.

English: Expose forced labor in agriculture through undercover investigations.
Kiswahili: Kufichua kazi ya kulazimishwa katika kilimo kupitia uchunguzi wa siri.
Ekegusii: Asioria ogokorigwa emeremo otancheti ase oboremi goetera obotuki bwansense.

English: Airports nationwide were placed on high alert with intensified screenings following a classified security memo.
Kiswahili: Viwanja vya ndege kote nchini vimewekwa katika tahadhari kubwa huku uchunguzi ukiimarishwa kufuatia taarifa ya usalama iliyofichwa.
Ekegusii: Ebitii biechindeke Kenya engima mbiabiaboretigwe koba maiso na komongera buya baria bonsi bagosoa ase ebitii ebio korengana nogokurerwa kwa ime kwarwetwe nabarendi boborendi.

English: Kenya's laws are evolving to better protect children's rights. Stay informed on legal changes affecting child welfare.
Kiswahili: Sheria za Kenya zinabadilika ili kulinda haki za watoto vyema. Endelea kupata taarifa kuhusu mabadiliko ya kisheria yanayoathiri ustawi wa watoto.
Ekegusii: machiko a Kenya akongiigwe erio korenda abana baria batari konyara kwerenda gose korwa emechie emetaka erio korenda oboronge bwa abana. Kabe gokomanyigwa igoro yamaonchorerio arengete ebiombe biabana.

English: Adjust vehicle mirrors to eliminate blind spots.
Kiswahili: Rekebisha vioo vya gari ili kuondoa madoa yasiyoonekana.
Ekegusii: Onchora ebirire bierori biria bikogonya korora magega erio otange omobasekano.

English: Be wary of strangers offering unsolicited help with ATMs or banking.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wageni wanaotoa msaada usioombwa na ATM au benki.
Ekegusii: Eborie buya igoro tabanto otamanyeti bakorwa ogokonya kwa bosa goetera obokoreri bwechisimi, (ATMs) gose ebengi.

English: Some communities still practice harmful traditions involving children. Report such cases to authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya jamii bado zinafuata mila hatari zinazowahusisha watoto. Ripoti visa kama hivyo kwa mamlaka mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande mbagenderete gokora ebienyechi buna ogekeba abanyaroka ebio bire mamincha noboronge bwa abana. Karwe eripoti yamang'ana ayio gochia ase abambi otari konyorwa.

English: Livestock are critical for livelihoods. Report distressed animals to veterinary officers for feed and medical support.
Kiswahili: Mifugo ni muhimu kwa riziki. Waripoti wanyama walio katika hali ngumu kwa maafisa wa mifugo kwa ajili ya chakula na usaidizi wa kimatibabu.
Ekegusii: Etugo negento iiengencho ase endangera.Manyia abanyagitari betugo yetugo eria ere ase obokong'u kobwenia nagochirageria amo nobokonyi boganeirie.

English: Don't carry large amounts of cash - use mobile payment options instead.
Kiswahili: Usibebe kiasi kikubwa cha pesa taslimu - tumia njia za malipo za simu badala yake.
Ekegusii: Tiga kobogoria chibesa chinyinge - rika riokobogoria chibesa, tumia chinhera chigedichitari.

English: Provide hotlines for reporting police abuse safely.
Kiswahili: Toa simu za dharura za kuripoti unyanyasaji wa polisi kwa usalama.
Ekegusii: Karwe chinamba chia moreromorero koripoti amagoso abasikari otari namochando.

English: Lost family members can be traced through Kenya Red Cross and social media platforms.
Kiswahili: Wanafamilia waliopotea wanaweza kufuatiliwa kupitia majukwaa ya Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya na mitandao ya kijamii.
Ekegusii: Abanto basirete nnabo barabwatigwe goetera ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) amo nabariki amangana na komanyia abanto amang'ana.

English: Institutions must coordinate across sectors to provide effective, compassionate responses to survivors.
Kiswahili: Taasisi lazima ziratibu katika sekta mbalimbali ili kutoa majibu yenye ufanisi na huruma kwa waathirika.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chiserikari ao ao goika kobwaterana korwa obokonyi obuya nobwanchani ase abakoreirwe bobe.

English: Know your rights and demand integrity from public officials to reduce corruption risks.
Kiswahili: Jua haki zako na udai uadilifu kutoka kwa maafisa wa umma ili kupunguza hatari za ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Manya oboronge bwa na boria ng'a abakoreri beserikari babe abeene ase emeremo yabo gokeania obokengeka.

English: Public advised not to circulate graphic images after the DusitD2 attack to protect victims' dignity.
Kiswahili: Umma ulishauri kutosambaza picha za picha baada ya shambulio la DusitD2 ili kulinda heshima ya waathiriwa.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi basabirwe tibasiarera chibicha chiokwoboi buna DusitD2 yaagetwe ebomu erio korenda amasikani ya baria baagetwe nepomu.

English: Social media artists released protest-themed music amplifying survivors' stories and urging public demand for police reform.
Ekegusii: Ebiombo biokomanyia amang'ana goetera chingero mbasogetie chingero chikorwa omogano bwa baria barasetwe nabasikari gosegeta abanainchi gosaba oboonchoreria ase amachiko abasikari.

English: Canada warns of terrorism near borders; avoid border areas.
Kiswahili: Kanada yaonya kuhusu ugaidi karibu na mipaka; epuka maeneo ya mpakani.
Ekegusii: Canada yarure ogokurerwa igoro yogoakwa chipomu chimbebe chia Kenya; kabe are nechimbebe.

English: Be cautious of 'distraction theft' tactics in public places.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu dhidi ya mbinu za 'wizi wa usumbufu' katika maeneo ya umma.
Ekegusii: Tigara komanyete buna abaibi chingencho abaibi bagotumia ase abanto bare abange koiba.

English: Local media reported calls for prosecution of officers accused of excessive force during Gen Z protests, urging IPOA and ODPP action.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari vya ndani viliripoti wito wa kushtakiwa kwa maafisa walioshutumiwa kwa kutumia nguvu kupita kiasi wakati wa maandamano ya Gen Z, wakihimiza hatua za IPOA na ODPP.
Ekegusii: Chisiteseni chai aiga inka chiokomnyia amang'ana nchiatebete konyora chisimi chikogosereri kobabwata na kopbasoera ase ogotangasa abasikari baria basoeretwe gotumia chinguru goetania ekero giokorobererekana chingaki chia Gen Z, na bakarigia ogokonya korwa IPOA na ODPP.

English: NPS published its official Community Policing Information Booklet to clarify roles, expectations and citizen engagement frameworks
Kiswahili: NPS ilichapisha Kijitabu chake rasmi cha Taarifa za Polisi Jamii ili kufafanua majukumu, matarajio na mifumo ya ushirikishwaji wa raia
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) nkiarwete egetabu kebwate eripoti igoro yoborendi bwebinyoro erio kobamanyia buna babwenerete gokora emeremo yabo, eke gekageire korwa ase bare bokobwaterana nabanyabinyoro.

English: Kenyans are warned to avoid online forex traders promising guaranteed profits. CBK does not license individuals to offer such services.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wanaonywa kuepuka wafanyabiashara wa fedha za kigeni mtandaoni wanaowaahidi faida iliyohakikishwa. CBK haiwape watu leseni ya kutoa huduma kama hizo.
Ekegusii: Abakenya bakureirwe gwetanga koonia chibesa chiechinse ao ao goetera eintaneti abanyabiasara bakongaina abanto nga abaita obonene mboreo. Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) teri korwa erensesi as omonto oyomo gkora agasi eyio.

English: Interior Cabinet Secretary reaffirms commitment to prosecuting acts that qualify as terrorism including destruction of property and threats to public services.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ime oenekirie okwerwa gweserikari gosera na kogambia ebikorwa bigosegeta obokebago amo nogari chinibo na korenta obwoba ase obokoreri bwa'banto.

English: High-density informal settlements require community-led safety efforts to reduce violence.
Kiswahili: Makazi yasiyo rasmi yenye msongamano mkubwa yanahitaji juhudi za usalama zinazoongozwa na jamii ili kupunguza vurugu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete chirandi mabaganetie okobwaterana newbinyoro erio gokeania chiburaburu.

English: Rumors worsen panic. Rely on official updates from government agencies and verified media outlets.
Kiswahili: Uvumi unazidisha hofu. Tegemea masasisho rasmi kutoka kwa mashirika ya serikali na vyombo vya habari vilivyothibitishwa.
Ekegusii: Amangana oborimo nigo akogesa obororo. Nyora amangana korwa aase aronge buna eserikari amo nabariki na abamanyi amangana bokwegenwa.

English: Follow special safety tips when driving during holidays.
Kiswahili: Fuata vidokezo maalum vya usalama unapoendesha gari wakati wa likizo.
Ekegusii: Bwatia emeroberio yabeene ekero okogendia erori chingaki chiamatuko yogotimoka korwa egasi.

English: Don't use the same password for Gmail, Facebook, and bank! If hacked, they'll all be gone.
Kiswahili: Usitumie nenosiri moja kwa Gmail, Facebook, na benki! Ikiwa zitadukuliwa, zote zitatoweka.
Ekegusii: Totumia enamba yesiri eyemo ase esimi, ebengi, akaonti ya Gmail, sose Facebook! Omonto aise gwesoi ase akaonti yao, onso aria kwabwate aroro nigo agosira pi na tokoyanyora rinde.

English: NPS urged by IPOA and oversight bodies to strengthen community policing to improve public trust
Kiswahili: NPS yahimizwa na IPOA na vyombo vya usimamizi kuimarisha polisi jamii ili kuboresha uaminifu wa umma
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kia abasikari NPS giasoroirwe nekeombe keria getenerete abasikari bonsi (IPOA) na bonsi baria bakorigereria emeremo yabasikari bae abarendi boborendi bwenyiro chunguru buna enchera eyemo yokoirania okwegena.

English: Support education and awareness campaigns protecting children, women, refugees, and vulnerable groups
Kiswahili: Saidia kampeni za elimu na uhamasishaji kuwalinda watoto, wanawake, wakimbizi, na makundi yaliyo hatarini
Ekegusii: Segeta chisemi goetera okobamanyia abanto oboronge bwabo, korenda abana, abakungu, baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo, na baria baria baranyare konyorwa nobokongu.

English: Don't display valuables in your car - keep them out of sight.
Kiswahili: Usionyeshe vitu vya thamani kwenye gari lako - viweke mbali na macho.
Ekegusii: Tiga kworokia ebinto bierigori ime yerori yao - keep them outside.

English: Anti‑corruption training reached officials and residents in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya kupambana na ufisadi yaliwafikia maafisa na wakazi katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Amasomo igoro yogotanga obokengeka naikerete abaofisa nabamenyi ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi.

English: Summary of UN counter terrorism strategies focusing on terrorism financing and international threat prevention.
Ekegusii: Okorora okweng'e nemeroberio yobomo bwa Boraya (UN) bwogokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu na gotanga baria bakoa ebibago chibesa gokora obokebago bwabo erio gotanga okogoswa korwa isiko.

English: Engage in antidiscrimination, refugee inclusion, and youth empowerment initiatives
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika mipango ya kupinga ubaguzi, ujumuishaji wa wakimbizi, na uwezeshaji vijana
Ekegusii: Bwaterana korwani ogokorera abanto bobe ekiagera eki bare, reta ange baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo, nemeroberio yokobeka abasae chinguru gose kobakonya.

English: Keep car keys in a secure location at home, not near doors/windows.
Kiswahili: Weka funguo za gari mahali salama nyumbani, si karibu na milango/madirisha.
Ekegusii: Gacha ebibunguo bierori yao inka ase agiya, korende tari ase omorangu gose etirisa.

English: Opposition leaders demanded the president's resignation after he appeared to endorse shoot-on-sight rhetoric during protests.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa upinzani walidai rais ajiuzulu baada ya kuonekana kuunga mkono kauli za watu wanaoonekana wakipigana risasi wakati wa maandamano.
Ekegusii: Abarai bopinsani mbaimokererete igoro koboria omorai bwense erusie emeremo ekero aitabete ng'a abanto bagosangerekana baraswe amagogoro abwo abwo buna enchera yokobeka asikari chinguri chiogogokorera bobe baria bakorobererekana.

English: NCTC unveiled the "Jasiri Observatory" public portal to help communities identify and counter extremist ideologies.
Ekegusii: keombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiaasioria omoroberio "Jasiri Observatory" eyio ere eintaneti yabainchi gokonya ebinyoro komanya na gotanga amasomo yogosaria abanto ebirengererio.

English: EACC has flagged a syndicate offering forged title searches and valuations in Kisumu. Use verified government channels only
Kiswahili: EACC imeripoti kuwa shirika linalotoa utafutaji na uthamini bandia wa hati miliki huko Kisumu. Tumia njia za serikali zilizothibitishwa pekee
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) yarure ogokurerwa igoro yamarube oborimo koa abanto emeremo, gose chinamba chiamaremo chioborimo, na korenga oboremo obwo nga nirenga boisaine aaria Kisumu. Tumia chiofisi chieserikari ekero otagete komanya ayio boronge.

English: Advisories recommend avoiding large gatherings and taking caution during religious and cultural events due to elevated risks.
Kiswahili: Ushauri unapendekeza kuepuka mikusanyiko mikubwa na kuchukua tahadhari wakati wa matukio ya kidini na kitamaduni kutokana na hatari kubwa.
Ekegusii: Obosemia obwo nigo bokomanyia ng'a bonsi baria bare ase emesangerekano yabanto abange buna chikanisa nemesikiti na emesangerekano ende yonsi babe maiso ekiagera yogoakwa chipomu okwo gokageire koba.

English: Kenya Meteorological Department issued a flash-flood advisory for seven counties and urged residents to take safety precautions.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya ilitoa ushauri kuhusu mafuriko ya ghafla kwa kaunti saba na kuwasihi wakazi kuchukua tahadhari za usalama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigeria rire buna rire nkiarwete ogkurera igoro yogocha kwembura enyinge nemegoko ime yechikaonti 7 naigo koboria abanto ng'a berende.

English: Download apps only from Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
Kiswahili: Pakua programu kutoka Duka la Google Play au Duka la Programu la Apple pekee.
Ekegusii: Nyora ebinto biria gigokonya esimi gokora emeremo yaye goetera Google Play Store gose Apple App Store.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre organized a five day workshop to contextualize a national manual on gender mainstreaming in counter terrorism.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaroberetie ogasanga amo kwegera komanya egetabu gekworokia buna okobwaterana na banto bechingencho ao ao nobomanyi bwabo erakonye korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.

English: African Anti‑Corruption Day linked corruption to human rights harm.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Kupambana na Rushwa ya Afrika ilihusisha rushwa na madhara ya haki za binadamu.
Ekegusii: Rituko riokoinyora egegi igoro yokorwania obokengeka aiga Africa ndirogetie buna obokorekanu bokomiga oboronge bwekemwanyabanto bwabanto.

English: Nairobi residents, beware of people who claim to provide business loans within an hour. The government does not have such a cash-in-hand program.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Nairobi, jihadharini na watu wanaodai kutoa mikopo ya biashara ndani ya saa moja. Serikali haina mpango kama huo wa pesa taslimu.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi ba Nairobi, kab maiso nabanto bagwekora ng'a nkorwa bare chironi chiebiasara ase engaki yensa eyemo yoka. Eserikari tebwati moroberio onga buna eyio bwechibesa koboko chiokorwa.

English: KAA heightened airport security after a bomb threat and advised early arrival for screening.
Kiswahili: KAA iliimarisha usalama wa uwanja wa ndege baada ya tishio la bomu na kushauri kuwasili mapema kwa ajili ya uchunguzi.
Ekegusii: Egetii giechindege kia Kenya (KAA) kiagesire oborendi ase egetii nyuma yobwoba bweombu goateka na gosaba baria bonsi bagochia koiruruka baike mapema gokorerwa oboringori.

English: Interior Ministry praises coordinated security actions.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoborendi bwa ime yatogiries emeroberio yokobwaterana ase oborendi.

English: Authorities notified the public of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and urged vigilance as additional troops were deployed.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka iliwaarifu umma kuhusu shambulio la Al-Shabaab huko Garissa na kuhimiza kuwa macho huku wanajeshi wengine wakipelekwa.
Ekegusii: Aabarai banyirie abanainchi igoro yobkebago bwogokwa epomu na Al-Shabaab aaria garisa Garissa na gosaba koba maiso buna enchera eyemo gokonya ebikosi bia abasikari biria biatomirwe.

English: Community policing campaign in Lamu engaged youth, elders, and security agencies to strengthen early warning and reporting systems.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya polisi jamii huko Lamu iliwashirikisha vijana, wazee, na mashirika ya usalama ili kuimarisha mifumo ya tahadhari na utoaji wa taarifa mapema.
Ekegusii: Oborendi bwebinyoro aaria Lamu mbabete nechinkwana chiogosegeta abasae, abakwani bebinyoro, neserikari buna bagokong'ia obomongeri komanya bwango ebikoru biobosaria na komanyia abarendi kegima.

English: Stay informed about government anti-corruption measures and encourage compliance
Kiswahili: Endelea kupata taarifa kuhusu hatua za serikali za kupambana na ufisadi na uhimize kufuata sheria
Ekegusii: Tigara komanyete buya emeroberio yeserikari gokinana nobokengeka ere na segeta abanto gosika amachiko.

English: National campaign encouraging the public to report suspicious activity to prevent terrorism related crimes.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kitaifa ya kuhamasisha umma kuripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka ili kuzuia uhalifu unaohusiana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omone bwense ogosegeta abanto komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwonsi bwokoruta chipomu.

English: NCTC coordinates prevention, detection, and disruption through outreach and capacity building.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete gokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkoraa kere emeroberio komanya na gotanga obokebago goetera ogosoka isiko na gokwana nabanto buna enchera eyemo yogokong'ia obokoreri.

English: Create a family emergency plan and meeting point for disasters.
Kiswahili: Unda mpango wa dharura wa familia na mahali pa kukutania majanga.
Ekegusii: Manyererania genkio nabanto benyoma yao aase ogotamera chingaki chiomobasekano.

English: Underage drug use leads to crime and health issues. Schools and parents should educate children on substance abuse dangers.
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya kwa watoto wachanga husababisha uhalifu na matatizo ya kiafya. Shule na wazazi wanapaswa kuwaelimisha watoto kuhusu hatari za matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya.
Ekegusii: Abana abake konywa amarwa nigo gokogesa obosaria nemechando ya afia. Nere buya chisukuru nabaibori basomie abana igoro yemachando yokonywa amarwa.

English: Reports show continued Al Shabaab activity near the Somalia border and call for sustained vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ripoti zinaonyesha shughuli za Al Shabaab zinaendelea karibu na mpaka wa Somalia na zinahitaji umakini endelevu.
Ekegusii: Chiripoti nkwrokia chire buna ebikoru bia Al Shabaab ang'e nechimbebe chia Somalia igo koboria koba maiso chingaki chionsi.

English: UN concerned over protest deaths; calls for accountability.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa una wasiwasi kuhusu vifo vya waandamanaji; wito wa uwajibikaji.
Ekegusii: Obiomo bwechinse chikwegambera (UN) nechandegete igoro yamakweri abaria bare koroberekana; baboririe eserikari kobogoria obobe obwo.

English: Never share OTPs.Even with 'bank staff'. Legit banks wont ask for them.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usishiriki OTP.Hata na 'wafanyakazi wa benki'. Benki halali hazitaki kuziomba.
Ekegusii: Tobaise gosanga OTPs. Nonya nase okori emeremo bwebengi'. Chibengi chiekeene tichiri koyesaba.

English: Demand accountability from public officials and uphold ethics to reduce corruption risks.
Kiswahili: Kudai uwajibikaji kutoka kwa maafisa wa umma na kudumisha maadili ili kupunguza hatari za rushwa.
Ekegusii: Boria komanyigwa buna abakori emeremo beserikari na renda ekeene gotanga obokorekanu.

English: NPS reiterated guidance for officers to use proportional force during protests and to prioritize peaceful engagement.
Kiswahili: NPS ilirudia mwongozo kwa maafisa kutumia nguvu sawia wakati wa maandamano na kuweka kipaumbele katika ushiriki wa amani.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabasikari (NPS) kiairoreire komanyia abasikari gotumia chinguru chinke chingaki chiokorobererekana na koba nobwororo chingaki bakoiranererania nabainchi.

English: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kutambua dalili za kiwewe na kutoa huduma ya kwanza ya kisaikolojia kwa manusura wa majanga.
Ekegusii: Tema komanya buna obwoba gose ogwechanda kwa abanto banyorirwe nomobasekano erio kobakonya korwania obwoba obwo goetera obosemia bwebirengererio na kobasira nchera ende yonsi erio banyare gotenenana kogenderera.

English: Media highlighted calls for an independent investigation into a custodial death, with families demanding prosecution and better detention oversight.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari viliangazia wito wa uchunguzi huru kuhusu kifo cha mtu aliyekamatwa, huku familia zikidai mashtaka na usimamizi bora wa kizuizini.
Ekegusii: Ebiombo biokomanyia abanto amangana mbiaboretie nga obotuki bwogwetenera bokorwe igoro yogokwa yabanto baria barenge eseri ya porisi, abowo ase baria bakweretwe nabamwabo nga abasikari basoerwe na buna baria bare ase chiseri chia porisi bakoreretwe gose barendire.

English: Climate disasters increase risks of violence. Preparedness must include violence risk assessments and mitigation actions.
Kiswahili: Maafa ya hali ya hewa huongeza hatari za vurugu. Utayari lazima ujumuishe tathmini za hatari za vurugu na hatua za kupunguza athari.
Ekegusii: Emechando yogoonchoreria kwerire nigo egosegeta abanto gokorerwa bobe. Emeroberio yogwetanga nayio goika erigererie ebinto biragere ogkorerwa bobe gose kogosererigwa na buna baranyare gotangwa.

English: Use official hotlines and online portals to anonymously report corruption for prompt law enforcement action.
Kiswahili: Tumia simu rasmi za dharura na milango ya mtandaoni kuripoti ufisadi bila kujulikana kwa ajili ya hatua za haraka za utekelezaji wa sheria.
Ekegusii: Tumia chiraini chieinteneti chiabeene na chiria korwa eripoti igoro igoro yobokorekanu otari kwemanyekani erio ebitambokero bibogorigwe

English: Victims of sexual abuse need medical, legal, and psychological support. Specialized centers offer free services nationwide.
Kiswahili: Waathiriwa wa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia wanahitaji usaidizi wa kimatibabu, kisheria, na kisaikolojia. Vituo maalum hutoa huduma za bure kote nchini.
Ekegusii: Baria bakoreirwe bobe gose gotibongwa nere buya konyora obokonyi bwobobwenia, kemachiko, anakebirengererio. Chisenta chiegeirie gokora emeremo eyio nkorwa chire obokonyi bwa bosa Kenya engima.

English: Advocacy group PRWG urged criminal responsibility for senior commanders whose subordinates commit misconduct and expansion of command responsibility doctrine.
Kiswahili: Kundi la utetezi la PRWG liliwahimiza kuwajibika kwa jinai makamanda wakuu ambao wasaidizi wao hufanya utovu wa nidhamu na kupanua mafundisho ya wajibu wa amri.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bwabarwanereri bia abasikari baria batenerete korigia amaonchorerio (PRWG) mbamanyetie abanene ba abasikari kobogoria amamocho abasikari babo abwo bakomocha ase chigasi chiabo goetera oggochoreria amachiko as ayio.

English: Do not leave cooking utensils uncovered when using cooking oil.
Kiswahili: Usiache vyombo vya kupikia vikiwa vimefunikwa unapotumia mafuta ya kupikia.
Ekegusii: Kunekeri chufuguri ekero ogotumia amaguta amaguta ogokaranga endagera.

English: Do not leave dangerous items within the reach of young children.
Kiswahili: Usiache vitu hatari karibu na watoto wadogo.
Ekegusii: Tiga kobeka ebinto bire atari ase abana ase baranyare kobikera.

English: Kenya Red Cross provided data on protest-related injuries and EMS response, urging improved pre-positioning of medical resources.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya ulitoa data kuhusu majeraha yanayohusiana na maandamano na mwitikio wa EMS, ukihimiza uboreshaji wa upangaji wa awali wa rasilimali za matibabu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiomoslaba omobaririri nkiarwete enamba ya baria baumiete ekero giokorobererekana na buna abanyagitari bemebasekano gokonya (EMS), na gosaba ng'a okobwekwa kwebinto biobonyagitari chinsemo chionsi chiokorobererekana bibeo.

English: Study report on Nyumba Kumi impacts in Migori County (Suna West)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya utafiti kuhusu athari za Nyumba Kumi katika Kaunti ya Migori (Suna Magharibi)
Ekegusii: Eripoti ya ayarorekanete goikerwa naobokoreri bwa Nyumba Kumi aaria ekaonti ya Migori (Suna West).

English: "DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya."
Kiswahili: "DCI inachunguza mpango bandia wa 'ruzuku ya vijana wanaoanza' unaosambazwa kwenye TikTok na Instagram. Hakuna mpango kama huo unaofadhiliwa na Serikali ya Kenya."
Ekegusii: Abanyanyimbo mbagendererete gotuka igoro yogochaka ogokonywa ase abasae neserikari ya Kenya goetera TikTok na Instagram. Gento kenga buna ekio tikeiyo korende noborimo bwoka.

English: Kenya launches a C-IED training complex to train security personnel.
Kiswahili: Kenya yazindua kituo cha mafunzo cha C-IED ili kuwafunza wafanyakazi wa usalama.
Ekegusii: Kenya yaansire esukuru yabeene kwegeria abakoreri baye boborendi buna bakomanya na gotegora chipomu chiokweroseria (C-IED).

English: Stampedes worsen disasters. Follow authorities' instructions and avoid panic during mass evacuations.
Kiswahili: Kukanyagana huzidisha majanga. Fuata maagizo ya mamlaka na epuka hofu wakati wa uhamishaji wa watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Ekere omobasekano obeire ekero abanto bakomigererania gotama nogo gokogesa emechando ende emenene. Bwatia ekere abarai bagoteba gokonya okomagamaga chingaki chiogokonya kwabanto abange.

English: Kenya introduced legislation regulating virtual asset service providers to reduce money laundering and terrorism financing risks.
Kiswahili: Kenya ilianzisha sheria inayodhibiti watoa huduma za mali pepe ili kupunguza hatari za utakatishaji fedha na ufadhili wa ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Kenya yaansire amachiko goyotanga baria bagotoma chibesa goetera eintaneti bakeanie oborosia bwechibesa pandia gosegeta obokebago ase akobaa chibesa echio.

English: Do not share your MPESA PIN with anyone. Safaricom and banks will never ask for it. If in doubt, call official support.
Kiswahili: Usishiriki PIN yako ya MPESA na mtu yeyote. Safaricom na benki hazitaiomba kamwe. Ikiwa una shaka, piga simu kwa usaidizi rasmi.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya MPESA nonde bwensi. Safaricom gose ebengi mbarikobori koboria nga obayetebie. Ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio, rangeria ebengi yao koboria buya okonywe.

English: Police presence and roadblocks set up in Machakos ahead of youth-driven Nane Nane protests as part of COP and crowd management readiness
Kiswahili: Uwepo wa polisi na vizuizi vya barabarani vimewekwa Machakos kabla ya maandamano ya Nane Nane yanayoendeshwa na vijana kama sehemu ya utayari wa COP na usimamizi wa umati
Ekegusii: Obonge bwabasikari nebirichanio biechipara biabekirwe Machakos nyuma yokororobekana kwabasae kwa Nane Nane erio gokinana nabarabwo buna omoroberio (COP) ase ogokinana na abanto abnge.

English: Back up important data to an external drive to avoid ransomware attacks.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi nakala rudufu ya data muhimu kwenye kiendeshi cha nje ili kuepuka mashambulizi ya ransomware.
Ekegusii: Rosia ekopi yamangana ao yengencho ase esimi goe ekombiuta gochia ekegachi kende terio gwekonya korwa ogosarigwa nebinyinyi

English: United Nations and Kenyan agencies co hosted workshops to help local officials and communities address incitement and prevent extremism.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa na mashirika ya Kenya yaliandaa warsha ili kuwasaidia maafisa wa eneo hilo na jamii kushughulikia uchochezi na kuzuia itikadi kali.
Ekegusii: United Nations amo na Kenyan nebitengo biaye mbaraete omosangerekano barai ba inse nebinyoro biabo gotanga obosegeti korwania obokebago bwogosaria obongo.

English: Reuters reported charges against activist Boniface Mwangi for alleged possession of tear gas and ammunition, raising concerns over politicized enforcement.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana ba Reuters mbamanyetie igoro mamamocho nogosoerwa kwomoegereri Boniface Mwangi nga nabwate ebinto biria bigwateka biarusia erioki nechimbunde mamincha nerichiko, eri riaretire obwoba buna siasa yatumekire kobuna amachiko.

English: A legal ruling confirmed IPOA's exclusive authority to investigate police misconduct and rejected attempts to limit its jurisdiction.
Kiswahili: Uamuzi wa kisheria ulithibitisha mamlaka ya kipekee ya IPOA kuchunguza utovu wa nidhamu wa polisi na kukataa majaribio ya kupunguza mamlaka yake.
Ekegusii: Okonacha gwekoti nkwaete ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) chinguru chiogotuka buna abasikari bagokora bobe na kwanga ogosaba ng'a chinguru chiabo chikeanigwe.

English: Kenya's county level action plans supporting prevention of radicalization and violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Emeroberion yechikaonti chia'Kenya nkworkia ere buna chikaonti chigosira eserikari gotanga ogosarigwa aobongo goetera amasomo amabe nobokebgo bwokuruta chipomu

English: United Nations facilitated regional training in Nairobi to strengthen gender responsive approaches in counter terrorism and preventing violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giense (UN) nkiaegeretie abarai bechingongo chia Nairobi erio gokwanera obokongu abanto bechingencho ao ao babwate ario gosegeta oboreng'ananu buna enchera eyemo yogotanga obokebago nogosarigwa ebirengererio.

English: US Embassy warned of potential unrest during primaries and urged citizens to avoid large gatherings.
Kiswahili: Ubalozi wa Marekani ulionya kuhusu machafuko yanayoweza kutokea wakati wa kura za mchujo na kuwasihi raia kuepuka mikusanyiko mikubwa.
Ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America aiga Kenya US Embassy) nyarwete ogokurera igoro yomoburakano ekero gwokorwanererera chitigiti chiebiama biegesiaia igo gosaba abanainchi berende gotaba ase emesangerekano emenene.

English: If your child is being bullied online, report it to the DCI Cyber ​​Unit immediately!
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtoto wako ananyanyaswa mtandaoni, toa taarifa kwa Kitengo cha Mawasiliano cha DCI mara moja!
Ekegusii: Onye omwana oo ogochandwa, kogoswa gose koramwa goetera eintaneti, manyia omonene bwobotuki otari konyorwa!

English: Actively participate in campaigns for safe, inclusive, and just community services.
Ekegusii: Bwaterana kegima ase ogosegeta oboronge, oborendi na gokorera abanto bonsi bekenyoro buya.

English: Visit the ASK Eldoret Show and stand with us in the fight against corruption. Together we can safeguard Kenya's future.
Kiswahili: Tembelea Kipindi cha ASK Eldoret na ushirikiane nasi katika mapambano dhidi ya ufisadi. Kwa pamoja tunaweza kulinda mustakabali wa Kenya.
Ekegusii: Tarera amaorokererio yoboremi (ASK) aaria Eldoret na koba oyomo oito ase okorwania obokengeka. Amo nabo torakonye Kenya ayito aiga motwe.

English: Outlines Anti Terrorism Police Unit operations focused on investigations and public cooperation.
Kiswahili: Inaelezea shughuli za Kitengo cha Polisi cha Kupambana na Ugaidi zinazolenga uchunguzi na ushirikiano wa umma.
Ekegusii: Nkworokereria are igoro yemeroberio ya yegekosi kia abasikari gokonana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu birengete obotuki na obosagani ebinyoro.

English: Citywide COP strategy building citizen coalitions for crime prevention in Nairobi City
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa COP kote jijini kujenga miungano ya raia kwa ajili ya kuzuia uhalifu jijini Nairobi
Ekegusii: Chinchera chibarendi boborendi bwenyoro Nairobi engima (COP) bagoetera gocha amo nakorosia ebiombe bioboamo gotanga obosaria omochie omonene o'Nairobi.

English: Warn drivers of wildlife crossing zones on highways.
Kiswahili: Onya madereva kuhusu maeneo ya kuvuka wanyamapori kwenye barabara kuu.
Ekegusii: Beka chisaini epara chikworokia ase chingiti chirosana chigotambera epara ase chipara chinene.

English: Use proper braking techniques in emergencies.
Kiswahili: Tumia mbinu sahihi za breki katika dharura.
Ekegusii: Manya buya chingaki obwenerete kobwata chibureki chingaki chiemebasekano.

English: Families of a shooting victim demanded legal action; IPOA confirmed active investigation and emphasized supervisory accountability.
Ekegusii: Amamwabo baria barasetie amasasi nabasikari mbaboretie ng'a ebotambokero biamachiko bibogorigwe as abasikari; ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) nkiaenegetie obotuki obuya na koboria nga abateneneri babasikari babogorie amamocho ayio.

English: Join us in the fight against corruption. Be part of the solution.
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi katika vita dhidi ya ufisadi. Kuwa sehemu ya suluhisho.
Ekegusii: Tobwatisies ase ekinano nobokengeka. Kabe oyomo ase okoreta ekeganeirie.

English: Neglect harms a child's development. Parents and guardians must provide basic needs, love, and security to prevent long-term trauma.
Kiswahili: Kupuuza huharibu ukuaji wa mtoto. Wazazi na walezi lazima watoe mahitaji ya msingi, upendo, na usalama ili kuzuia majeraha ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ogotarenda gose koa omwana ebinto atagete nigo ekogocha ogokina na okogenderera kwomwana. Abaibori nabarendi babana goika bae abana babo ebi bakonyara, buna obwanchani, noborendi gotanga mechando yebirengererio nogochandeka ase engaki entambe.

English: Automation of the self-declaration process is now live. Uphold integrity by complying online today.
Kiswahili: Mchakato wa kujitangaza kiotomatiki sasa unaendelea. Dumisha uadilifu kwa kufuata sheria mtandaoni leo.
Ekegusii: Okwemanyekania aye omonyene igoro yenibo obwate bono nigo ogekorwa goetera egedichitri gose eintaneti. Segeta obokeene ase ogoikerania ayio goetera eintaneti.

English: DCI urged citizens to submit crime complaints or tips directly to DCI offices or email to improve investigative response.
Kiswahili: DCI iliwasihi raia kuwasilisha malalamiko ya uhalifu au vidokezo moja kwa moja kwa ofisi za DCI au barua pepe ili kuboresha majibu ya uchunguzi.
