Ekegusii: Omosikari omonene bwobotuki (DCI) osoroire abanainchi babe bagotoma okwemurangania kwabo gose bosemia konde gwonsi gochia asare ere omonyene gose komotomera eimeiri erio kwangoyia obotuki nokoiraneria.

English: Assessment noting high terrorism threat levels in the United States from domestic and foreign violent extremists.
Kiswahili: Tathmini ikibainisha viwango vya juu vya vitisho vya ugaidi nchini Marekani kutoka kwa watu wenye msimamo mkali wa ndani na nje ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Okorenga kwa beene nkwaorogetie ase ebirengo bia igoro ng'a okonyarekana kwogoakwa chipomu aaria America korwa ebibago bia ime na korwa isiko.

English: Emergency contacts are: Police (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
Kiswahili: Watu wa dharura wanaowasiliana nao ni: Polisi (999), Ambulensi (911), Zimamoto (990).
Ekegusii: Chinamba chiemebasekano: Porisi (999), Erori ya Ambulance (911), Omorero bwatekire (990).

English: Always wear a helmet when riding a bodaboda - it saves lives!
Kiswahili: Vaa kofia ngumu kila wakati unapoendesha bodaboda - inaokoa maisha!
Ekegusii: Kera engaki beka ehofia eri egokorende ekero kiomobasekano korinete epigipigi - ngokonya ere obogima!

English: Advisory urging reporting of suspicious activity in public spaces such as schools, concerts, and sporting events.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa kuhimiza kuripotiwa kwa shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka katika maeneo ya umma kama vile shule, matamasha, na matukio ya michezo.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera korwa eserikari korigetie abanto korwa amang'ana gochia agambi igoro yebikoru biechitang'utang'u aase abanto bakobera buna chisukuru, chinyomba chiokwegokeria, amo nechogosori.

English: University of Nairobi research documents community policing implementation success and barriers in Kibera, Ruai and Ziwani areas
Ekegusii: Amanga arikire yamasomo yokorigia chisemi chinyia neyunifasity ya Nairobi nkworokia are oboikeranu bwabeene ase emeremo yabarendi boborendi bwenyoro amo nechando ereo ase ebinyoro bia Kibera, Ruai na Ziwani.

English: Presents the national strategy for preventing and reversing radicalization.
Ekegusii: Nkorwa kere omoroberio bwense gokongia abanto gwetanga gosoa obokebago namasomo agosaria obongo.

English: We advise Kenyans not to share photos of their ID, NHIF or voters card on Facebook job groups. These details are being harvested for fraud
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri Wakenya kutoshiriki picha za vitambulisho vyao, NHIF au kadi za wapiga kura kwenye vikundi vya kazi vya Facebook. Maelezo haya yanakusanywa kwa ajili ya ulaghai.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosemia abanto ba Kenya tibasanga chipicha chibibande chiabana babo, chiria chia nyagitari (NHIF ) gose chikadi chiogoaka chikura ase okorigia emeremo goetera Facebook. Amangana aya yabana bao nigo agotumika gokora obosaria.

English: Kenya, Indonesia, and the Netherlands held a joint knowledge sharing program to improve strategies for preventing and countering violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Kenya, Indonesia, amo na Netherlands mbabete nogocha amo koererania oboinga'ini nechisemi gokong'ia emeroberio gotanga na korwania obokebago bwogosaria obongo.

English: IPOA announced a prosecution outcome in a Nyeri manslaughter case involving a police officer, underscoring accountability progress.
Ekegusii: Ekoti ekanacha ekina ng'a ekeombe keria getenenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo (IPOA) nkere nokobua koringoria amamocho abasikari bakora igo ekanga ogosaba ng'a chinguru chiabo chikeanigwe.

English: The United Kingdom warns of high terrorism risk in Kenya, especially targeting UK interests.
Kiswahili: Uingereza yaonya kuhusu hatari kubwa ya ugaidi nchini Kenya, hasa ikilenga maslahi ya Uingereza.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa Boraya (United Kingdom) bwarure ogokurera igoro yokonyarekana goakwa nebibago bwokoruta chipomu aiga nka Kenya, mono kegima birengete abanto bense yabo abwo bare iaga Kenya nebinto biabo.

English: EACC stresses multi‑sector participation, using technology to strengthen anti‑corruption action.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokorekanu (EACC) kiaboririe okobwaterana nebitengo ao ao, goetera etekinorochi gokong'ia korwania obokorekanu.

English: An encyclopedic overview documented causes, fatalities, economic triggers, and arrest numbers from the 2025 protests.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa ensaiklopidia uliandika sababu, vifo, vichocheo vya kiuchumi, na idadi ya kukamatwa kutokana na maandamano ya 2025.
Ekegusii: Amangana ase oboamo arigetwe naorogetie ekiaretete, omkoumia kwabanto, okomigwa kiuchumi kebogoko buna egesegeto, na enamba ya baria babwatetwe ekero giokoroberereka kwa 2025.

English: Warn drivers about dangers of weaving between traffic; stay alert.
Kiswahili: Waonye madereva kuhusu hatari za kuingiliana kati ya magari; kuwa macho.
Ekegusii: Kurera omonterefa ekero akomigereria ase chirori chinyinge chire; kabe maiso.

English: United Kingdom advisory urges continued vigilance due to unpredictable threats in public places, hotels, and religious sites.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa Uingereza unahimiza kuendelea kuwa macho kutokana na vitisho visivyotabirika katika maeneo ya umma, hoteli, na maeneo ya kidini.
Ekegusii: Obosemia korwa United Kingdom bwasabire omongeri bwakogenderera ase engencho yogotamanyereria ekero ebibago birarute chipomu ase abanto, chinyomba chiokoragera, naase gosabera.

English: NPS debunked a fake terror warning poster and cautioned against misinformation.
Kiswahili: NPS ilikanusha bango bandia la onyo la ugaidi na kuonya dhidi ya taarifa potofu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gia abasikari (NPS) nkiarwete oboene igoro yongainereri goetera amariko ogokurera anantetigwe chinaysi bwogoakwa epomu na gokurera abanto batige korwa amangana agotantania.

English: Fake job offers like 'Earn KSh 50k daily from home' are scams.Avoid upfront payments.
Kiswahili: Ofa bandia za kazi kama vile 'Pata KSh 50k kila siku kutoka nyumbani' ni ulaghai. Epuka malipo ya awali.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yoborimo buna Nyora chinusi chilifu 50 kera rituko korwa nka' namangana oborimo agotumeka gokora oboibi. Tiga korwa chibesa omanye konyora chibesa.

English: Kenya's judiciary is automating courts to improve transparency nationwide.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inaendesha mahakama kiotomatiki ili kuboresha uwazi kote nchini.
Ekegusii: chikoti chia Kenya chiansire obokoreri goetera eintaneti goikerania obomaisomarore bwemeremo Kenya engima.

English: Update on United States Treasury sanctions targeting terrorism financing networks.
Kiswahili: Taarifa mpya kuhusu vikwazo vya Hazina ya Marekani vinavyolenga mitandao ya ufadhili wa ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Uamangana abwango korwa Ekegncha ekenene giesirikari ya America gosieka chibengi chiabanto gete na kobeka ebisusuro ase abamochi buna enchera eyemo yogatanga koa ebiombe biebibago chibesa.

English: ODPP introduced tech tools and plea deals to cut case backlogs.
Kiswahili: ODPP ilianzisha zana za kiteknolojia na mikataba ya madai ili kupunguza mrundikano wa kesi.
Ekegusii: Ofisi yomosoeri ebina (ODPP) yaansete egekoreri kigedichitarierio kwangoi gokora ebina ebinge korwa abwo magega.

English: KNCHR tells of citizen engagement programs boosting security and human rights awareness in Kisumu County
Kiswahili: KNCHR inasimulia kuhusu programu za ushirikishwaji wa raia zinazoimarisha usalama na uhamasishaji wa haki za binadamu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gia Kenya kerendete oboronge bwa mwanyabanto (KNCHR) ngoteba bare igoro yemeroberio yokobwaterana buna yakong'irie oborendi na obomanyi igoro yoboronge bwa mwanayabanto aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu

English: Ticks spread deadly diseases. Regular dipping, chemical rotation, and daily inspections protect livestock.
Kiswahili: Kupe hueneza magonjwa hatari. Kuogesha mara kwa mara, mzunguko wa kemikali, na ukaguzi wa kila siku hulinda mifugo.
Ekegusii: Amagecha nigo agotambokeri amairwaire amabe ase etugo. Koira etugo chidipu, gochenchia amariogo ase edipu, gose goyesibia ase okoyesiarera eriogo riogoita amagecha nepambu, na korigereria kera rituko nga etugo yao tebwati amagecha.

English: The 2025 update to the Prevention of Terrorism Act strengthens Kenya's capacity to prosecute terrorism.
Ekegusii: Okogesa gochia richiko ria omwaka 2025 igoro yogotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu ngakongetie chinguru chia Kenya gosoera na kogambia ebibago ebio.

English: Fake DHL parcel alerts are common scams.Verify via official customer service.
Kiswahili: Arifa bandia za vifurushi vya DHL ni ulaghai wa kawaida.Thibitisha kupitia huduma rasmi kwa wateja.
Ekegusii: Amanagana agokomanyia igoro yemesigo yoborimo goetera DHL nenchera eyemo abanto bakongainwa. Rigia komanya buya emeremo ekambani eyio egokora.

English: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa sera wa Kenya unahakikisha usimamizi wa maafa ulioratibiwa. Elewa haki zako na majukumu ya serikali.
Ekegusii: Amachiko aKenya igoro yobokoreri ekero kia omobasekano nkoenekia are ng'a okobeaterana nekomoti yemebasekano. Manya aboronge bwao neki eserikari ebwenerete kogokorera.

English: Download apps only from official stores like Google Play or Apple App Store.
Kiswahili: Pakua programu kutoka kwa maduka rasmi kama vile Google Play au Apple App Store pekee.
Ekegusii: Nyora ebinto biria bigokonya esimi gose ekombiuta gokora emeremo korwa aase egenire buna Google Play gose Apple App Store.

English: Enhanced airport and public‑space security aims to protect visitors.
Kiswahili: Usalama ulioimarishwa wa viwanja vya ndege na anga za umma unalenga kuwalinda wageni.
Ekegusii: Oborendi bwebitii biechindege nechisitechi chiokorinera chirori oborendi bwagesirwe borengete korenda abanto, abageni bagocha aiga nense.

English: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.
Kiswahili: Wazee wanahitaji mipango maalum ya uokoaji. Tambua walezi na makazi yanayoweza kufikiwa mapema.
Ekegusii: Abanto abagotu mbaganetie enchera yabeene kobatamia korwa emebasekano. Beka abatenereri babo amo nase oraibaire kobera motwe yokobatania korwa omobasekano.

English: Early warning prevents losses. Monitor conditions and share forecasts with herders.
Kiswahili: Onyo la mapema huzuia hasara. Fuatilia hali na ushiriki utabiri na wafugaji.
Ekegusii: Komanya omochando bwango nigo kogotanga asara. Rigeria buya komanya rire buna rire na sanga nabatugi bamino.

English: Use fog lights correctly to enhance visibility.
Kiswahili: Tumia taa za ukungu kwa usahihi ili kuongeza mwonekano.
Ekegusii: Okia ebitochi biria ebike bierori yao kore para kworokia ng'a erori ngocha ere.

English: Interior CS briefed Senate on national security readiness and coordinated agency efforts.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ine namanyetie ekegambero gieseneti buna yeariganetie ase oborendi bwense na okobwaterana nebitengo ao ao.

English: A live radio program educated listeners on detainee rights, proper custody treatment, and legal recourse for abuse.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha redio cha moja kwa moja kilielimisha wasikilizaji kuhusu haki za wafungwa, utunzaji sahihi wa watoto, na njia ya kisheria ya kuchukua hatua dhidi ya unyanyasaji.
Ekegusii: Amasomo goetera eredio nasomitie abategereri oborionge bwabaria bare chiseri chia polisi, buna babwenerete korendwa buya ime yeseri, na ekibaranyare gokora onye bakorereirwe bobe.

English: Campaign to end stigma against mental health patients.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kukomesha unyanyapaa dhidi ya wagonjwa wa afya ya akili.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogosemia gotanga gochaya abarwaire bebiregerio biobongo.

English: KNCHR urges action on human rights abuses and safety risks.
Kiswahili: KNCHR yahimiza hatua kuchukuliwa dhidi ya ukiukwaji wa haki za binadamu na hatari za usalama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorwanerera oboronge bwanyabwanto (KNCHR) giasabire egetambokero igoro yogokorerwa bobe goge kogosereria oborendi bwomonto.

English: Kenya Methodist University/IJRISS research shows community policing significantly improves service delivery and trust in Nairobi County
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Methodist cha Kenya/IJRISS unaonyesha kwamba polisi jamii inaboresha kwa kiasi kikubwa utoaji wa huduma na uaminifu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi
Ekegusii: Eyunifasiti ya Kenya Methodist University kobwaterana na nechiyunfasiti chinde igoro yokorigia chisemi chinyia igoro yobobwenia nabanto korwa Belgium (IJRISS) yaorogetie ng'a oborendi bwebinyoro nobwengencho ase okorwa oborendi bwokwegena aaria ekaonti ya Nairobi.

English: Religious institutions influence community norms. Clergy training and counseling support safe and equitable environments.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za kidini zinaathiri kanuni za jamii. Mafunzo na ushauri nasaha wa makasisi huunga mkono mazingira salama na yenye usawa.
Ekegusii: Chidini ngosegeta chire buna ebinyoro bikorosia amachiko ekemira. Gosomia barai bechidini nigo egokonya gosegeta ababwatai babo korenda amasingira.

English: A civic-tech initiative published live maps of protest zones, police deployments, and safe routes to enhance demonstrator safety.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa teknolojia ya kiraia ulichapisha ramani za moja kwa moja za maeneo ya maandamano, kupelekwa kwa polisi, na njia salama ili kuimarisha usalama wa waandamanaji.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogotumia eintaneti oansirwe okworokia aase okorobererekana kware gokoreka Kenya engima, buna abasikari batometwe, nechinchera chiokominchoreria ase ogokonya abarobererekani.

English: Follow strategic plans like the Kenya Integrity Plan to enhance sector-wide transparency
Kiswahili: Fuata mipango ya kimkakati kama vile Mpango wa Uadilifu wa Kenya ili kuboresha uwazi katika sekta nzima
Ekegusii: Bwatia omoroberio bwogokora emeremo buna oria o 'Kenya bwobokeene (Kenya Integrity Plan) kwangoi obokoreri ao ao bwa maiso marore ase eserikari.

English: IPOA inspected forensic labs and case files to improve evidence integrity and transparency in criminal investigations.
Kiswahili: IPOA ilikagua maabara za uchunguzi wa kimatibabu na faili za kesi ili kuboresha uadilifu wa ushahidi na uwazi katika uchunguzi wa jinai.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) nkiarogereretie buya chifaeri chiebina goikerania oboikeranu bwebinto bikworokia buna amagoso arenge ase enchera yamaiso marore ase obotuki bwebina.

English: Community support networks assist survivors by providing safe spaces, trained volunteers, empowerment programs, and coordinated referrals while prioritizing safety and confidentiality.
Kiswahili: Mitandao ya usaidizi wa jamii huwasaidia waathirika kwa kutoa nafasi salama, watu wa kujitolea waliofunzwa, programu za uwezeshaji, na marejeleo yaliyoratibiwa huku ikipa kipaumbele usalama na usiri.
Ekegusii: Ebokundi biogosira ase ebinyoro nigo bigokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe ase enchera yokobaa aase bakobera atari namochando onde bwonsi goetera abakonyi babo bokwerwa begeirie buya, kobasira goetera ebinto bike bike bikobakonya, na kobwaterana gochia ase baranyare konyora obokonyi ao ao, oborendi bwaigoro nobobisi bwabo.

English: DCI cautions the public against forged university admission letters being used to defraud parents. Always verify admission directly with the institution.
Kiswahili: DCI inaonya umma dhidi ya barua bandia za udahili wa chuo kikuu zinazotumiwa kuwadanganya wazazi. Daima thibitisha udahili moja kwa moja na taasisi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Omotuki omonene okureire aanainchi igoro yamarube yogosa eyunifasiti yoborimo agendererete gotimeka kongaina na koibera abaibori. Kera engaki chungusa rirube riogosoa eyunifasiti goetra uyunifasiti enyene.

English: NCTC conducted training for county officials on raising public awareness and preventing radicalization.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiasometie abarai bechikaonti buna baramanyie abanto babo buna baranyare gotanga amasomo ogsaria abanto ebirengererio.

English: Join civil society initiatives to advocate for transparency and governance reforms.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na mipango ya asasi za kiraia ili kutetea uwazi na mageuzi ya utawala.
Ekegusii: Soa ase omoroberio bwa NGO erio gosegeta obomaiso marore gose obokeene namaonchorerio buna obogambi bobwenerete koba .

English: A youth movement organized a peaceful march demanding justice for protest victims and reforms to use-of-force protocols.
Kiswahili: Harakati ya vijana iliandaa maandamano ya amani wakidai haki kwa waathiriwa wa maandamano na mageuzi ya itifaki za matumizi ya nguvu.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa'basae mwatwarete okorobererekana kwomorembe omotienyi 3 koboria ekeene igoro ya baria baumisetwe nabasikari amo nogoonchoreria kwamachiko igoro yekerengo giechinguru abasikari babwenerete gotumia.

English: "Communications Authority has launched a hotline for reporting impersonation scams involving fake mobile providers. Dial 0800 222 777 to report."
Kiswahili: "Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano imezindua simu ya dharura kwa ajili ya kuripoti ulaghai wa uigaji unaohusisha watoa huduma bandia za simu. Piga 0800 222 777 ili kuripoti."
Ekegusii: "Ekeombe getenenerete oboererania bwamang'ana giaansire enamba ya morero gokonya koyemanyia gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagwekona nga nkorwa bare obokoreri beintaneti. Aka esimi 0800 222 777 koyemanyia amang'ana ayio."

English: Posters distributed nationwide explained suspects' rights, legal search limits, and how to file complaints with oversight bodies.
Kiswahili: Mabango yaliyosambazwa kote nchini yalielezea haki za washukiwa, mipaka ya utafutaji wa kisheria, na jinsi ya kuwasilisha malalamiko kwa vyombo vya usimamizi.
Ekegusii: Ebinto bwabwate amariko are komanyia oboronge bwomokagerwa, ekerngo giokomotababa, na buna oranyare gosoera abasikari gochia ase baria bakomongera buna abasikari bagokora emeremo.

English: US Embassy imposed travel restrictions for staff in six counties due to insecurity.
Kiswahili: Ubalozi wa Marekani uliweka vikwazo vya usafiri kwa wafanyakazi katika kaunti sita kutokana na ukosefu wa usalama.
Ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America (US Embassy) aiga Kenya mbwarwete ogokurera gochia abanto babo koba maiso gotarera chikaonti 6 aiga Kenya ekiagera oborendi botaisaine aroro.

English: Message encouraging citizens to recognize and report suspicious behavior noting that vigilance strengthens community security.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe unaowahimiza raia kutambua na kuripoti tabia za kutiliwa shaka ukibainisha kuwa uangalifu huimarisha usalama wa jamii.
Ekegusii: Amangana amenge esimi koa abanainchi emioyo buna bakomanya na korwa eripot igoro yebikoru biechitangutangu bamanyete buya ng'a koba maiso nenchera eyemo yogokongia oborendi bwebinyoro.

English: Biosecurity prevents disease outbreaks. Disinfect footbaths, quarantine new animals, control wildlife access, and report sick animals promptly. Proper carcass disposal is essential.
Kiswahili: Usalama wa kibiolojia huzuia milipuko ya magonjwa. Safisha vijidudu kwenye bafu za miguu, karantini wanyama wapya, dhibiti ufikiaji wa wanyamapori, na toa ripoti kwa wanyama wagonjwa haraka. Utupaji sahihi wa mizoga ni muhimu.
Ekegusii: Gotanga okoererania etugo korwa ensemo eyemo gochia eyende nigo egotana okwambokerana kwamarwaire yetugo nabanto. Beta chiombe esindani yoborwaire bwomonwa namagoro, chiombe chikorwaa gochia aria chichanche, renda chingiti chiorosana tichiika ange, na karwe eripoti ioro yetugo erwarete otrikonyorwa. Tindeka etugo eri yakure inse kabisa.

English: Use crossing points and traffic lights where available.
Kiswahili: Tumia sehemu za kuingilia na taa za trafiki inapopatikana.
Ekegusii: Tumia gotamboka epara aase ebimanyererio bibekire gose chitochi chikogotebia ekero obwenerete gotamboka epara.

English: Use steering wheel locks as additional deterrent for vehicle theft.
Kiswahili: Tumia kufuli za usukani kama njia ya ziada ya kuzuia wizi wa gari.
Ekegusii: Sieka gose richania egento keria kierori omorundia erori agotumia goonchorana amagoro gakoyegendi (Obureki) buna enchera eyo yogotanga teibwa.

English: Unified action is needed in the war against graft. Stand firm, report corruption.
Kiswahili: Hatua ya pamoja inahitajika katika vita dhidi ya ufisadi. Simama imara, ripoti ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Okobwatera amo nkoganeirie erio gosegeta esegi ase obokorekanu. Tenena bokong'u, teba ase obokorekanu bore.

English: Kenya and Indonesia held a Nairobi–Mombasa workshop to share community based approaches and draft a memorandum of understanding on PCVE collaboration.
Kiswahili: Kenya na Indonesia zilifanya warsha ya Nairobi-Mombasa ili kushiriki mbinu zinazotegemea jamii na kuandaa hati ya makubaliano kuhusu ushirikiano wa PCVE.
Ekegusii: Kenya na Indonesia mbabete negeikaranso kia Nairobi – Mombasa gosanga buna ebinyoro biranyare korika amang'ana okoigwanana gose kobwatana igoro yogotanga ogosarigwa ebirengererion gwancha obokebago bwogotumia chinguru (PCVE) ase oboamo.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre promotes the See Something Say Something campaign encouraging prompt reporting of suspicious activity.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngoseta kere ng'a kore omoroberio okorokwa "rora egento - teba gente gete" ogosegeta abanto komanyia abarai bwango amangana gose ebikoru biechitang'utang'u.

English: Katiba Institute reported constitutional rights violations during protests and urged judicial safeguards and rights-based policing.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Katiba iliripoti ukiukwaji wa haki za kikatiba wakati wa maandamano na kuhimiza ulinzi wa mahakama na polisi inayozingatia haki.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Katiba Institute nkiamanyetie buna okobunwa kwa amachiko nabasikari kware gokorwa kwegosa gotaiyo chingaki chiokorobererekana na gosaba bororo ng'a amachiko atumeke korenda abakorobererekana buna oboronge bwabo.

English: If you have farms, clearly label fertilizers and pesticides.
Kiswahili: Kama una mashamba, weka lebo wazi kwenye mbolea na dawa za kuua wadudu.
Ekegusii: Onye kobwate omogondo bwoboremi, orokereria buya obwoyo mborobi, n amariogo boigo.

English: IPOA opened a comprehensive investigation into allegations of police misconduct during June protests, including use of live rounds and mass detentions.
Kiswahili: IPOA ilianzisha uchunguzi wa kina kuhusu madai ya utovu wa nidhamu wa polisi wakati wa maandamano ya Juni, ikiwa ni pamoja na matumizi ya risasi za moja kwa moja na kuwekwa kizuizini kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) nkiagorete obotuki obonene komanya igoro yokwemuranganania ng'a abasikari mbakorete meremo yabo buya chingaki chiokorobererekana kwomotienyi 6, amo nogotumia chimbunde bobe na kobeka abanto ase egesibo getari kiaboronge.

English: Reliable data systems track violence trends and service use to inform evidence-based policies and programs.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya data inayoaminika hufuatilia mitindo ya vurugu na matumizi ya huduma ili kutoa taarifa kuhusu sera na programu zinazotegemea ushahidi.
Ekegusii: Amangana aria arikire amaikeranu buna chiripoti chiabasikari, chianyagitari na NGOs chikworokia buna abanto bagokorerwa bobe erio gokonya korosia amachiko nemeroberio yokobakonya.

English: EACC trained leaders and citizens in Nandi on integrity.
Kiswahili: EACC iliwafunza viongozi na raia wa Nandi kuhusu uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorwania obokengeka (EACC) kiaegeirie abarai nabainchi aaria ekaonti ya Nandi igoro yekeene.

English: Be cautious of strangers asking for personal or financial information.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu dhidi ya wageni wanaouliza taarifa binafsi au za kifedha.
Ekegusii: Erende korwa abanto otamanyeti bagokobori amangana igoro yao gose chibesa chiao.

English: Verify charities before donating online.Fake fundraisers are common.
Kiswahili: Thibitisha mashirika ya kutoa misaada kabla ya kutoa michango mtandaoni.Michango bandia ni ya kawaida.
Ekegusii: Kongoria buya ebiombe biria bigosaba ogokonywa goetera eintaneti otararwa besa ende yonsi. Abarigia chibesa boborimo nao bare.

English: If you see a power cable fallen, stay away and call 999 immediately.
Kiswahili: Ukiona kebo ya umeme imeanguka, kaa mbali na upigie 999 mara moja.
Ekegusii: Korarore omorande bwesitima ogwete inse, toika ang,e rangeria enamba ya morero ya porisi 999 otari konyorwa.

English: Save emergency numbers in your phone.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi nambari za dharura kwenye simu yako.
Ekegusii: Beka chinamba chiesimi orarangerie konyora ogokonywa chingaki chiomobasekano

English: Several students have lost fees to fake school accounts shared on WhatsApp. Always pay school fees through officially designated bank accounts.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi kadhaa wamepoteza karo kutokana na akaunti bandia za shule zinazoshirikiwa kwenye WhatsApp. Lipa karo za shule kila wakati kupitia akaunti za benki zilizoteuliwa rasmi.
Ekegusii: Abana abange basisiririe chibesa chiesukuru fisi goetera chiakaonti chioborimo chibekire WhatsApp. Chingaki chionsi akana chibesa chiesukuru goetera ebengi yesukuru yekeene.

English: Corruption threatens security and growth. Report unethical conduct to safeguard public resources.
Kiswahili: Rushwa inatishia usalama na ukuaji. Ripoti mwenendo usio wa kimaadili ili kulinda rasilimali za umma.
Ekegusii: Obokengeka nokokosia ase aborendo namagenderero. Karwe eripoti yebikoru ore nechitangutangu gose ogokora gotabwenereti gochia ase abarai korena obonda bwebinyoro na Kenya.

English: Ensure school vans are properly licensed and drivers vetted to prevent accidents and kidnappings.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha magari ya shule yana leseni ipasavyo na madereva wamechunguzwa ili kuzuia ajali na utekaji nyara.
Ekegusii: Rora nga chirori chisukuru nchuibwate chirensesi buya nomotereba buya achoretwe korenga gotanga emebasekano na koibwa kwa abana.

English: US Embassy issued advisory warning of heightened crime and terror risks and urged caution.
Kiswahili: Ubalozi wa Marekani ulitoa onyo la ushauri kuhusu hatari kubwa za uhalifu na ugaidi na kuhimiza tahadhari.
Ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America (US Embassy) aiga Kenya yarwete ogosemia kwogokurera igoro yobosareku bwaigoro mono nokonyarekana kwobokebago na gosaba koba maiso.

English: Government reaffirmed its commitment to combating cattle rustling through intensified patrols in the North Rift.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilithibitisha tena kujitolea kwake kupambana na wizi wa mifugo kupitia doria zilizoimarishwa katika North Rift.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yaenekirie okwerwa kwaye gokora oboibi bwechiombe goetra obomongeria bwaye ase chipara nechinchera ase abaibi bagoetia chiombe chioboibi aaria ensemo ya North Rift.

English: Civil society networks across Africa push for transparency. Support governance-strengthening efforts.
Kiswahili: Mitandao ya asasi za kiraia kote Afrika inasukuma uwazi. Saidia juhudi za kuimarisha utawala.
Ekegusii: Okobwaterana kwebiombe bitari bieserikari Africa engima mbagendererete gosuguma obomaiso marore ase obokoreri. Sira emeroberio eye egokongia obogambi obuya.

English: NCRC survey shows Kenyans want COP to tackle drug abuse, professionalism and slow investigations
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa NCRC unaonyesha Wakenya wanataka COP kukabiliana na matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya, taaluma na uchunguzi wa polepole
Ekegusii: Obokongoria bwekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korigia chisemi chinyia chiogotanga obosaria (NCRC) nigo bookorokia ng'a abanto ba Kenya mbatagerte omonene otenerete obokoreri bwasikari (COP) akore omochando bwogotumia bobe amarigo nebinto biogotindia ase obotuki bwa bwango.

English: Create inventory of household items with photos and receipts for insurance.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza orodha ya vitu vya nyumbani ukitumia picha na risiti za bima.
Ekegusii: Rika inse ebinto bionsi bia mwao. biake chibicha na gacha amarisiti kwabigorerete gonya insuarensi kogoakana ekero birayie gose koibwa.

English: Kenya and the United Kingdom opened a new Anti Terrorism Police Unit facility in Mombasa to strengthen operations.
Kiswahili: Kenya na Uingereza zilifungua kituo kipya cha Kikosi cha Polisi cha Kupambana na Ugaidi huko Mombasa ili kuimarisha shughuli.
Ekegusii: Kenya nobomo bwa Boraya mbaigorete egetuo kiabasikari kegokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu aaria Mombasa gokongia obokoreri.

English: Interior Ministry announced increased multi‑agency patrols during the festive season to deter crime.
Ekegusii: Eministiri ya yoborendi bwa ime goetera abitengo ao ao yamentete ogoonchokanana korenda obokebago chingaki chia amatuko emeyega ao ao gotanga obokebago.

English: Report economic crimes and procurement fraud to demonstrate community commitment to justice.
Kiswahili: Ripoti uhalifu wa kiuchumi na ulaghai wa ununuzi ili kuonyesha kujitolea kwa jamii kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Manyia abarai igor obosaria bwobogoko nobokengeka ase okogora chitenda chieserikari buna enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene.

English: Media oversight body condemned arrests and assaults on journalists covering protests, calling for an independent inquiry into press violations.
Kiswahili: Shirika la usimamizi wa vyombo vya habari lililaani kukamatwa na kushambuliwa kwa waandishi wa habari wanaoripoti maandamano, likitaka uchunguzi huru kuhusu ukiukwaji wa vyombo vya habari.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba Media oversight body mbatebete koba bobe okobwatwa na ogoakwa kwabariki amang'ana bare korika na kobwata buna okorobererekana kware gokorwa, na koboria nga obokongori bwabeene bokorwe komnya ninki kiagerete abariki amanga bare gosaganerwa.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre helped develop social media monitoring systems to detect hate speech and radical ideologies while protecting freedom of expression.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiakonyete korosia chinchera abariki amangana baranyare komongera, koigwa na komanya amangana, chinkwana gose ebiorokererio biokogosereria, gochegia, gose gosegeta ogochaya abande egekogera eki bare, na chisemi chiogosaria ebirengererio ase okwebisa ime yerichiko riobosibore bwogokwana.

English: EACC raised awareness at the 2025 Eldoret Show on reporting corruption.
Kiswahili: EACC ilitoa uelewa katika Onyesho la Eldoret la 2025 kuhusu kuripoti ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) ngiakorete okomanya omoerio bwomwaka 2025 aaria ase amoorokereria yoboremi Eldoret buna aranyare koria eriporti igoro yobokorekanu.

English: Reuters reported the arrest of activist Mwangi over alleged possession of tear gas and ammunition during protests, widely condemned as political intimidation.
Kiswahili: Reuters iliripoti kukamatwa kwa mwanaharakati Mwangi kwa madai ya kumiliki gesi ya machozi na risasi wakati wa maandamano, ambayo yamelaaniwa sana kama vitisho vya kisiasa.
Ekegusii: Abamanyi amangana ba Reuters mbamanyetie ense igoro yomoegereri Mwangi ase okomebekerera ng'a nabwate ebinto biria bikoraswa korwa erioki amo nechimbunde chingaki chikoroberekana, na kwanga okogoserigwa konga buna okwo kwegesiasa kwoboi abakoroberekana.

English: Human Rights Watch released video analyses showing police use of live rounds, teargas, arbitrary arrests, and command-authorized force.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekomongera oboronge bwa mwanyabanto nkiarwete esinema ekworokia buna abasikari bare korasa chimbunde, koruta ebinto biria bikorusia erioki, kobwata abanto bosaigo, negetengo kiabasikari inse yamachiko korwa abanene babo korasa chimbunde.

English: The Ministry of Public Service reminds job seekers that all internship postings are free to apply for. Avoid anyone asking for bribes or airtime in return
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Utumishi wa Umma inawakumbusha wanaotafuta kazi kwamba nafasi zote za mafunzo ya vitendo ni bure kuomba. Epuka mtu yeyote anayeomba rushwa au muda wa maongezi kama malipo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yobokoreri bwabanto nkoinyoria are abakorogia egasi nga baria bakorigia gosoa ase okwegera mono igoro yamosomo abo nigo agwancherwa na gosoa bosa. Kana monto onde bwensi oragosabe riaki.

English: Parliamentary amendment strengthening legal frameworks to combat terrorism financing and regulate virtual assets.
Kiswahili: Marekebisho ya Bunge ya kuimarisha mifumo ya kisheria ya kupambana na ufadhili wa ugaidi na kudhibiti mali pepe.
Ekegusii: Ogoochoreria kwa amachiko na Bunge gwakong'irie amachiko gokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu na baria bakobaa chibesa goetra eintaneti gokora obosaria.

English: Global partnerships enhance anti‑corruption efforts through stronger enforcement and transparency.
Ekegusii: Okobwaterana nense engima ngokongia kore gokinana nobokengeka goetera obokoreri mwamachiko bwechinguru na obomaiso marore.

English: Learn to build temporary shelters using locally available materials for displaced families.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kujenga makazi ya muda kwa kutumia vifaa vinavyopatikana katika eneo husika kwa ajili ya familia zilizopoteza makazi.
Ekegusii: Egera koacha chinyomba ogtumia ebinto bigotoka inka ase bari baseretigwe korwa aase bare abwo nyuma.

English: Be on the lookout for criminals who use NGOs to launder money
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wahalifu wanaotumia mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kutakasa pesa
Ekegusii: Kabe maiso igoro yebibago bigotumia NGOs korosia chibesa chia pandia.

English: Let's avoid sharing propaganda, unverified information, and graphic images in order not to add to the distress of the affected.
Kiswahili: Tuepuke kushiriki propaganda, taarifa zisizothibitishwa, na picha za picha ili tusiongeze dhiki kwa walioathiriwa.
Ekegusii: Totige korandarandia amangana yoborimo, amangana ataramanyekana boronge, amo nechibicha erio titoba abakogesa obororo ase baria bare nobokong'u.

English: Report road accidents, unsafe vehicles, and reckless driving to authorities.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ajali za barabarani, magari yasiyo salama, na uendeshaji wa magari bila kujali kwa mamlaka.
Ekegusii: Manyia igoro yemebasekano yepara, chirori chitari ase enchera engiya, nobogendia obobe gochia ase abagambi gose abasikari.

English: Police Reforms Working Group calls for stronger COP
Kiswahili: Kikundi Kazi cha Mageuzi ya Polisi chataka COP imara zaidi
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia baria bagokora amaonchorerio ase obokoreri bwabasikari nigo kegosaba ogokongigwa kwa abarendi boborendi (COP)

English: Always check expiry dates on food products to avoid food poisoning.
Kiswahili: Daima angalia tarehe za mwisho wa matumizi ya bidhaa za chakula ili kuepuka sumu ya chakula.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki mongera chitariki chiendagera kogunda otaragora erio bwerende gotara na koria endagera eng'undo ekoretere obokong'u.

English: Observe curfews and security directives to support local safety measures.
Kiswahili: Fuata amri za kutotoka nje na maagizo ya usalama ili kuunga mkono hatua za usalama za eneo husika.
Ekegusii: Bwatia amachiko buna arure nabarai una enchhera eyemo yoborendi erio korenda oborendi bwenyoro kiao.

English: Contaminated feed causes losses. Test for aflatoxins and store feed safely.
Kiswahili: Chakula kilichochafuliwa husababisha hasara. Jaribu sumu ya aflatoxins na uhifadhi chakula kwa usalama.
Ekegusii: Endaera enchafu yetugo nigo ekorenta asara. Pima komanya gose engaera eyio nebwae obobosu na gacha endagera eyio buya.

English: Public guidance on basic cybersecurity practices to protect against online threats and promote digital safety.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera ase abanto bonsi chinchera chinyororo chiokorenda esimi nekombiuta yao erio korenda ng'a esimi gose ekombiuta yao, amangana ao naye omonyene tibinyora nabako amabe yobosaria goetera eintaneti erio gosegeta oborendi goetera egedichitari.

English: Sports academies must have policies against physical and sexual abuse of young athletes.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya michezo lazima viwe na sera dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kimwili na kingono wa wanariadha wachanga.
Ekegusii: Aaria ase abanto bagosomera gokora chogosori goika babe namachiko agotanga gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore gose ogotabatabwa ase abanyagosori abasae.

English: Pilot sub county forum launched to build community trust and improve public reporting as part of the national countering violent extremism strategy.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la majaribio la kaunti ndogo limezinduliwa ili kujenga uaminifu wa jamii na kuboresha utoaji wa taarifa kwa umma kama sehemu ya mkakati wa kitaifa wa kukabiliana na ugaidi wa vurugu.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano ase chikaonti inke yakoretwe korenta obwegenwa ase abanainchi na gokong'ia emeroberio ya abaninchi korwa chiripoti buna ensemo yemoroberio yeserikari gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.

English: Use flashlights instead of candles to prevent fires during blackouts. Report downed power lines to Kenya Power.
Kiswahili: Tumia tochi badala ya mishumaa ili kuzuia moto wakati wa kuzimwa kwa umeme. Ripoti nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka kwa Kenya Power.
Ekegusii: Tumia chitoci ase oborabu erio gotanga ogwateka kwomorero ekero esitima etaiyo.Manyia abanto besitima igoro yemerande yesitima eyio egwete inse.

English: Police in Malindi cutting juvenile crime through new initiatives.
Kiswahili: Polisi mjini Malindi wapunguza uhalifu wa vijana kupitia mipango mipya.
Ekegusii: Abasikari aaria Malindi babogoirie ebitambokero biogotanga obosari gati yabana goetra emeroberio emyia.

English: Nairobi informal settlements community policing case study with relevance to wider Nakuru experience.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa kesi za polisi jamii katika makazi yasiyo rasmi ya Nairobi unaohusiana na uzoefu mpana wa Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Ayanyorekanete arengete abarendi boborendi ase emechie yechirandi aaria Nairobikoreng'ana na ayare aaria Nakuru engima.

English: In disasters (floods, fires), children are most vulnerable. Ensure they are evacuated safely and receive psychosocial support.
Kiswahili: Katika majanga (mafuriko, moto), watoto ndio walio hatarini zaidi. Hakikisha wanahamishwa salama na wanapata usaidizi wa kisaikolojia.
Ekegusii: Ekero kiemebasekano buna (etoigo, nopgwateka kwemerero), abana nabwo bagochandeka mono ekiagera batari naguru chigokonya. Rora ng'a batammigwe gose korusigwa aroro buya na bae ogokonywa kwebirengererio goetra okobakwanera.

English: Government recognized GBV as a national security threat and called for inter‑agency collaboration.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilitambua GBV kama tishio la usalama wa taifa na ikataka ushirikiano kati ya mashirika.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarorire ogkorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore (GBV) koba ringana rokogosereria eborendi bwense na koreta amo ebitengo bieserikari kobwaterana.

English: IG banned arms in disturbed areas; surrender weapons to police.
Kiswahili: IG ilipiga marufuku silaha katika maeneo yenye vurugu; walisalimisha silaha kwa polisi.
Ekegusii: Omorai omonene bwa'basikari (IG) ochikire abanto gotwara chibunduki aaria ase are nechisagano; Bwatoka chibundukigochia ase abasikari.

English: Academic findings on drivers of COP success and constraints in Migori County's Nyumba Kumi program
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya kitaaluma kuhusu vichocheo vya mafanikio na vikwazo vya COP katika mpango wa Nyumba Kumi wa Kaunti ya Migori
Ekegusii: Amasomo abeene aorokirie buna omosangerekano bwabasangi ase oborendi (COP) bwakonyire gokeania emechando aaria ekaonti ya Migori goetera omoroberio O'Nyumba Kumi.

English: Informal settlements are prone to fires due to congested housing and illegal electricity connections. Report hazards and use fire-safe cooking methods.
Kiswahili: Makazi yasiyo rasmi yanakabiliwa na moto kutokana na msongamano wa nyumba na miunganisho haramu ya umeme. Ripoti hatari na utumie njia za kupikia salama kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Abanto mamenyete ase emechie eagachire gotabwatia omoroberio omoronge bwobwagachi na ekomonteranete nigo bare ase emechando bwechinyomba chaibo koiya nomorero asengencho chinyomba chiabi chibwataine nabo igo okobeka esitima ase enchera yoboibi.Karwa amang'ana igoro yomorero na tumia chinchera chingiya chiokorisia endagera.

English: University of Nairobi case study of challenges in Cop implementation in Kibera
Ekegusii: Ayarorekanete goetera okomanya kweyunifasity ya Nairobi igoro yemechando ereo ase ogoikerania obokoreri bwabarendi boborendi (Cop) aaria Kibera.

English: Snakes bite animals in dry seasons. Clear bushes and seek immediate treatment for bites.
Kiswahili: Nyoka huuma wanyama wakati wa kiangazi. Safisha vichaka na utafute matibabu ya haraka kwa kuumwa.
Ekegusii: Chingiti chingenda nse nkorasa chire etugo aaria chingongo chinyomo. Rabia orsana na rigia obowenia bwa bwango ase etugo yao rasirwe neng'iti engenda nse.

English: Install motion-activated lights in dark areas around your property.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha taa zinazowezesha mwendo katika maeneo yenye giza karibu na nyumba yako.
Ekegusii: Beka ase enkna yao gose ase enibo yao ere ebirobu biesitima biria ekero biarorire omonto botuko bigwoka gokomanyia nga onto nare isiko.

English: Women living with HIV face increased risks and barriers. Integrated health, counseling, and legal services provide essential support.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanaoishi na VVU wanakabiliwa na hatari na vikwazo vilivyoongezeka. Huduma jumuishi za afya, ushauri nasaha, na sheria hutoa msaada muhimu.
Ekegusii: Abakungi bawate endwari yenyamoreo mbwango konyorwa nobobe nebitango. Obobwenia ase oboamo, obosemia, amo nogokonywa kemachiko nkorwabire ogokonya kwabeene.

English: Regional training of trainers workshop in Nairobi promoted gender sensitive counter terrorism policies across East Africa.
Ekegusii: Okwegerigwa kwa abarai bechingongo buan abegeria abande aaria Nairobi nosegetete engencho yokorenta amo abanto bechingencho chionsi buna enchera eyemo yokorwania gotanga koruta chipomu orgongo rwa Afrika ya Mocha engima (East Africa).

English: National rollout of the prison based CVE awareness program reached over thirty thousand officers through national and international partnerships.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omonene bwabasikari bechera noansete komanyia buna chinchera chiogotanga obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio oyio oikerete goetania abaofisa chilifu 30,000 goetera okobwaterana Kenya ase okobwaterana nense engima.

English: Personal safety plans help individuals prepare for dangerous situations by identifying safe locations and strategies for protection.
Kiswahili: Mipango ya usalama wa kibinafsi huwasaidia watu kujiandaa kwa hali hatari kwa kutambua maeneo salama na mikakati ya ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio oo aye omonyene kwerenda ngokonya ore kwebanga chingaki chiokong'u ase okomanya boronge ase ogotamera gochia na buna okwerenda.

English: Use timers for lights when away to give appearance someone is home.
Kiswahili: Tumia vipima muda kwa ajili ya taa ukiwa mbali ili kuonyesha kama kuna mtu nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Ekero gwasokire gochia esafari, beka chitochi chia chiesitima chinsa chireokie chinyene buna egento giokworokia nga omonto nare nka.

English: Summary of tactics used in Westgate, Garissa, and Dusit attacks with government guidance on reporting, preparedness, and emergency response.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa mbinu zilizotumika katika mashambulizi ya Westgate, Garissa, na Dusit pamoja na mwongozo wa serikali kuhusu kuripoti, utayari, na majibu ya dharura.
Ekegusii: Obwenge bwa'mangana igoro yechinchera chiatumegete goaka chipomu aaria Westgate, Garissa, na Dusit eserikari yarwete oborai buna abariki amang'ana na komanyia amangana ayio abanto yakoretwe, koba maiso, na ekere kiare gokorwa chingaki echio chiemebasekano.

English: Stakeholders including police chiefs and counselors trained in GBV community policing and awareness in Kisumu County
Kiswahili: Wadau wakiwemo wakuu wa polisi na washauri waliofunzwa kuhusu ulinzi na uhamasishaji wa jamii kuhusu GBV katika Kaunti ya Kisumu
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi amo nabasikari na baria bonsi batagegete oborendi amo nabasemia basomiigwe igoro komanyia abanto igoro yobobe bwogochaya gose gokorera abande bobe ase enncho yeki bare aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu

English: Survivors of disasters often face trauma. Free counseling is available at government health centers and through NGOs.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingi manusura wa majanga hukabiliwa na kiwewe. Ushauri nasaha wa bure unapatikana katika vituo vya afya vya serikali na kupitia mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali.
Ekegusii: Abatigari bemebasekano chingaki chinyinge nigo bakweiranana.Obotebereria na obokonyi bwa bosa mboreo ase chinyagitari chieserikari na goetera ebiombe biria bitari bieserikari(NGOs).

English: KNCHR highlighted activism as a tool to expose corruption and demand accountability.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorigereria oboronge bwa mwanyabanto (KNCHR) yaorokire buna obosemia nogosuguma buna egekoreri ekenene goasioria obokorekanu na gosaba ng'a obotenereri obuya bwobokoreri.

English: A quantitative summary outlined protest timelines, injuries, deaths, arrests, and legislative outcomes to contextualize state response.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa kiasi ulielezea ratiba za maandamano, majeraha, vifo, kukamatwa, na matokeo ya kisheria ili kuainisha muktadha wa mwitikio wa serikali.
Ekegusii: Amangana amanene arikire ase obwenge naorogetie chinsa, buna abanto baumiete, abkwete, ababwatetwe, na ekere kiabete kworokereria buna eserikari egokora emeremo yaye.

English: CBK warns Kenyans against sending money to social media groups promising weekly payouts from investment plans. These are unregulated and illegal.
Kiswahili: CBK inawaonya Wakenya dhidi ya kutuma pesa kwa vikundi vya mitandao ya kijamii na kuahidi malipo ya kila wiki kutoka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji. Hizi hazidhibitiwi na ni kinyume cha sheria.
Ekegusii: Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) yakureire abaKenya igoro yogotoma chibesa gochia chigurupu chiembeo bakobangaina konyora obwaita kera ewiki. Ebinto binga buna ebio tibiri bia amachiko igo nebiobong'ainereria.

English: EACC marked national celebrations highlighting corruption's impact on dignity and services.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorwania obojkengeka (EACC) ekero kiegeikaranso kierituko rinene okorurerwa igoro yobokengeka kiarengete gosegeta obwegenwa ase obokoreri.

English: Ministry of Interior advised evacuations in conflict-prone and flood-affected areas and deployed emergency response teams.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ilishauri uhamishaji katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na migogoro na mafuriko na kupeleka timu za kukabiliana na dharura.
Ekegusii: Eminisirtiri yoborendi bwaime yarwete ogosemia abanto barwe chngongo chiria neminano na chiria chigoterema amache na gotoma baria bagokonya elero kiemebasekano.

English: Children involved in legal processes should receive specialized legal aid through the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaohusika katika michakato ya kisheria wanapaswa kupokea msaada maalum wa kisheria kupitia Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi wa Mashtaka ya Umma.
Ekegusii: Abana abwo bare ase okoariganigwa gotamigwa mamincha yerichiko neganeirie konyora obokonyi mwachiko bosa goetera ofisi yomoteneneri bwobosoi ebina (ODPP).

English: Keep walkways well-lit at night to prevent accidents and deter crime.
Kiswahili: Weka njia za kutembea zikiwa na mwanga mzuri usiku ili kuzuia ajali na kuzuia uhalifu.
Ekegusii: Rora nga nobegeta chitaya ase abanto bagoetera botuko ase ogotanga emebasekano yomonto kogochwa and gotanga obosaria.

English: Industrial pollutants harm animals. Report dumping, fence off contaminated sites, and test water.
Kiswahili: Uchafuzi wa viwandani huwadhuru wanyama. Ripoti utupaji taka, uzio mbali na maeneo yaliyochafuliwa, na jaribu maji.
Ekegusii: Obochafu bokorwa ase chifakitori nigo bokorentera etugo obokongu. Karwe eripoti igoro gotuguta obochafu bwabo ase enchera etari engiya, gita aase eubochafu bogotugutwa, na pima amche komanya gose nabwate ebinyinyi.

English: Reuters captured escalating violence in Nairobi protests, including burning vehicles amid outrage over a blogger's death in custody.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana ba Reuters mbabwatete buna eburaburu yarenge aaria Nairobi, na gosamba chirori ase obororo bwogokwa kwomoriki amangana bwogwetenenera ase eseri ya porisi.

English: Missing Voices published a registry of killings and disappearances among youth during Gen Z protests, calling for formal investigations.
Kiswahili: Missing Voices ilichapisha sajili ya mauaji na kutoweka kwa vijana wakati wa maandamano ya Gen Z, ikitaka uchunguzi rasmi ufanyike.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba Missing Voices mbarigete buna abasae bare goitwa, gokenganigwa gose kobiswa ekero giokorobererekana kwa Gen Z, na koboria ng'a obotuki bwakeene bokorwe.

English: A procurement ban bill seeks to deter corruption through strict penalties.
Kiswahili: Muswada wa marufuku ya ununuzi unalenga kuzuia ufisadi kupitia adhabu kali.
Ekegusii: Richiko riyia nigo ririgetie gotanga obokorekanu bwechikambani gose abanyabiasara baria abakorekanu goetera kwanga gokora emeremo neserikari goika emiaka 10 buna egesusuro.

English: Technology supports gender-based violence prevention through safety apps and digital tools that offer emergency contacts and discreet help-seeking features.
Ekegusii: Etekinorochi ngokonya ere gotanga ogokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore goetera ebikoreri bioborendi bwaya amo negedichitari konyora chinamba chiesimi korigia ogokonya otari kwemanyekania.

English: Investigate abuse of domestic workers; raise public awareness.
Kiswahili: Chunguza unyanyasaji wa wafanyakazi wa majumbani; ongeza uelewa wa umma.
Ekegusii: Tuka buya amangana yabakori emeremo yechinka; Kongia okomanyia abanto obobe bwogokorera bobe abakori emeremo bnka.

English: NSSF has suspended several field agents found collecting cash for 'special processing. NSSF does not charge for fast-tracking services
Kiswahili: NSSF imewasimamisha kazi mawakala kadhaa wa shambani waliopatikana wakikusanya pesa kwa ajili ya 'usindikaji maalum. NSSF haitozi malipo kwa huduma za haraka
Ekegusii: Ekeoombe keria ekenene kiabagotu (NSSF) kiabutire abakori emeremo abange banyoretwe bagosangereria chibesa korwa abagotu erio kobakonya korosia chibesa chiobogotu bwabo. NSSF teri gosaba besa chinde chionsi ekero ekobwatia komanya ayakorengete.

English: Proper slaughter methods protect meat safety. Only use licensed slaughterhouses or follow public health guidelines for home slaughter.
Kiswahili: Njia sahihi za kuchinja hulinda usalama wa nyama. Tumia vichinjio vilivyoidhinishwa pekee au fuata miongozo ya afya ya umma kwa ajili ya kuchinja nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Obonyenyi etugo obuya na gacha enyama buya protect. Tumia ebichinchio biria biancheire gose bwatia amachiko yobochenu ekero okonyenya etugo yao nka.

English: High threat of kidnapping targeting foreigners in northern and coastal areas and travelers are urged to avoid high risk zones.
Kiswahili: Tishio kubwa la utekaji nyara unaolenga wageni katika maeneo ya kaskazini na pwani na wasafiri wanahimizwa kuepuka maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
Ekegusii: Obwoba bwa igoro bwokobwatwa na kobiswa kwabanto korengete abarwa isiko bamenyete aaria Irianyi mbarabare nenyancha na baria bonsi bagotumia chigari ase rogendo baboriigwe gotaika ange nchinsemo echio chiregire nobokebago.

English: Do not leave your vehicles open or valuables visible.
Kiswahili: Usiache magari yako wazi au vitu vya thamani vionekane.
Ekegusii: Tomocha gotasieka erori yao gose gotiga ebinto biengencho kororekana ime.

English: Kenya Police measures to combat terrorism and violent extremism focusing on the Anti Terrorism Police Unit.
Kiswahili: Hatua za Polisi wa Kenya za kupambana na ugaidi na itikadi kali zikizingatia Kitengo cha Polisi cha Kupambana na Ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio ya abasikari ba Kenya arengete abasikari baria boborendi bwogotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu, namangana yosaria obongo goetera amorokererio amabe.

English: Check 'Serena_254's' profile to see if it's legit before accepting the friend request.
Kiswahili: Angalia wasifu wa 'Serena_254's' ili kuona kama ni halali kabla ya kukubali ombi la urafiki.
Ekegusii: Risegereria komanya inki 'Serena_254's' erengete nyuma otarakora kende nabarabwo.

English: National Assembly strengthens laws to detect and prevent terrorism financing and improve transparency across financial systems.
Kiswahili: Bunge la Kitaifa linaimarisha sheria za kugundua na kuzuia ufadhili wa ugaidi na kuboresha uwazi katika mifumo yote ya fedha.
Ekegusii: Bunge yakong'irie laws yokomanya na gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu n baria bakobaa chibesa gokora ayio naboigo koba maiso marore buna chibesa chigoeta anaboko abanto.

English: Share the road safely with cyclists.
Kiswahili: Shiriki barabarani kwa usalama na waendesha baiskeli.
Ekegusii: Renda korora ng'a kwarure ribaga rigiya ase abagendi chinyange ekero mogoetana.

English: Nakuru County officials led a public forum at Elementaita station engaging local CPC members and community representatives to strengthen COP partnerships
Ekegusii: Abarai bekaonti ya Nakuru mbabete nomoroberio obonsi aaria esiteseni ya Elementaita gokwanerana nechikomiti chia abarendi boborendi (CPC) nabateneneri bebinyoro gokong'ia obokoreri bwabarendi boborendi (COP)ase okobwaterana.

English: Mining areas require strict policies and safety measures to prevent harassment and exploitation.
Kiswahili: Maeneo ya uchimbaji madini yanahitaji sera kali na hatua za usalama ili kuzuia unyanyasaji na unyonyaji.
Ekegusii: Okorema amadini nigo koganetie amachiko amaikeranu noborendi gotanga okorera abande bobe, kogechi gose gochaya nakobarianania .

English: Mining Department and NCTC jointly trained stakeholders on safe handling of commercial explosives to mitigate terror risks.
Ekegusii: Eminisiti yokorema amadini na keombe keria getenenerete gotanga na korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ase oboama baegeirie abasangi buna babwenerete kogacha, kobirenda kobibogoria na kobitumia buna enchera eyemo yogotanga ogosaganwa korwa isiko.

English: Keep shrubbery near entry points low to maintain visibility.
Kiswahili: Weka vichaka karibu na sehemu za kuingilia chini ili kudumisha mwonekano.
Ekegusii: Simeka amaoga ase omorangwa gose egesona kiao.

English: Use ad blockers to stop malicious pop-ups like 'Youve won an iPhone!'.
Kiswahili: Tumia vizuizi vya matangazo ili kuzuia madirisha ibukizi hasidi kama vile 'Umeshinda iPhone!'.
Ekegusii: Tumia egento kegotanga amangana ogotangasa ebiasara buan kwanyorire esimi iPhone eye nencher eyemo yogotanga ebinyibigosaria esimi giose ekombiuta yao.

English: Persons with disabilities face higher risks of violence. Services must meet accessibility needs and provide inclusive support.
Kiswahili: Watu wenye ulemavu wanakabiliwa na hatari kubwa zaidi za vurugu. Huduma lazima zikidhi mahitaji ya ufikiaji na kutoa usaidizi jumuishi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaremaru nigo bagokorerwa bobe kobua abanto bande. Ogokonywa kobarengete goika goikeranie buna bagoikerwa nokogania kwabo ase bonsi.

English: US global caution highlights terrorism threats; stay vigilant.
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya kimataifa ya Marekani inaangazia vitisho vya ugaidi; endelea kuwa macho.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa gochia ense korwa America nkworokia kore okonyarekana kwobokebago bokoruta chipomu; kabe maiso.

English: Community forums sponsored by IOM improved trust and intelligence sharing between residents and security.
Kiswahili: Mabaraza ya jamii yaliyofadhiliwa na IOM yaliboresha uaminifu na ushiriki wa kijasusi kati ya wakazi na usalama.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano yebinyoro yasiretwe nekeombe giense igoro yobonganyi (IOM) yasegetete okwegenana na gosanga amang'ana obotuki gati ya abanto bebinyoro nabarendi boborendi.

English: Video report on Special Operations Group activities countering terror threats in high risk border areas.
Ekegusii: Esinema yaorogeti buna ebi egekundi kiabasikari kiabeene kiegeirie buya kegima erio gosagana obwoba bwokutita chipomu aase aria yechimbe chia Kenya aregire nogoakwa chipomu.

English: Calls for stronger consumer education and digital safety to address cyber threats.
Kiswahili: Inatoa wito wa elimu bora kwa watumiaji na usalama wa kidijitali ili kukabiliana na vitisho vya mtandao.
Ekegusii: Okoboria gwechinguru ng'a abagokorerwa emeremo basemigwe igorro yoboronge bwabo na buna babwenerete kwerenda gedichitari erio gotanga obwoba korwa eintaneti.

English: Community policing reduces livestock theft. Share intelligence and support police investigations.
Kiswahili: Polisi jamii hupunguza wizi wa mifugo. Shiriki akili na usaidie uchunguzi wa polisi.
Ekegusii: Oborendi bwebinyoro nogo bogokeania oboibi bwetugo. Karwe amanagana obotuki na bwatisia porisi kobeka oborendi.

English: Let's work with Police to arrest criminals hiding in #Maandamano to steal, destroy properties and commit other crimes.
Kiswahili: Tushirikiane na Polisi kuwakamata wahalifu waliojificha katika #Maandamano ili kuiba, kuharibu mali na kufanya uhalifu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Tiga tokore emeremo amo nabasikari kobwata ebibago biebisete ase amaanadamano erio koiba, dgosaria ebinto kobakora abande koba ebibago.

English: IMLU report on community policing committees in Narumoru (serving Nyeri and Nyandarua region)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya IMLU kuhusu kamati za polisi jamii huko Narumoru (zinazohudumia mkoa wa Nyeri na Nyandarua)
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia IMLU kiarure eripoti igoro yechikomoti chiabarendi boborendi aaria Narumoru (egokorera ensemo ya Nyandarua)

English: United Nations factsheet guiding civic groups on protecting human rights during counter terrorism work.
Ekegusii: Egetabu kiobomo bwechinse chiria chikwegambera (UN) igoro yokorenda oboronge bwamwanyabanto chingaki chiogokinana nobokebago bwokoruta hipomu.

English: "CBK is aware of mobile apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. CRB requests are processed through licensed bureaus only."
Kiswahili: "CBK inafahamu kuhusu programu za simu zinazotoza ada za 'kibali cha CRB' mapema. Maombi ya CRB yanashughulikiwa kupitia ofisi zenye leseni pekee."
Ekegusii: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK ) nemanyete ebikoreri biechisimi apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. Ogosaba gochia baria batenenerete ogosaria kwobogoko (CRB) nigo kogokorwa nabanto bancheire gokora egasi eyio boka"

English: Install security cameras at entry points and make them visible.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha kamera za usalama kwenye sehemu za kuingilia na uzifanye zionekane.
Ekegusii: Beka chikamera chikobwata buna abanto bagosoa na gosoka korwa bwoo as omorangu gose egeita hirirekanete buya.

English: Don't leave spare keys in obvious places like under doormats or flowerpots.
Kiswahili: Usiache funguo za ziada katika sehemu zinazoonekana wazi kama vile chini ya mikeka ya mlango au vyungu vya maua.
Ekegusii: Totiba ekopi yebinguo biao bia kobera aase aamo engaki entambe buna inse yomogeka bwenyomba gose ase enyongo yamaoga - bichenchie kera engaki.

English: Interior Ministry condemned attacks on security installations.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ililaani mashambulizi dhidi ya vituo vya usalama.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoborendi bwaime Inogo yaroche bobe ogosariwa kwebinto bieserikari.

English: "Fraudsters posing as election observers have been soliciting money from aspirants for fake clearance. IEBC does not charge for clearance forms."
Kiswahili: "Walaghai wanaojifanya waangalizi wa uchaguzi wamekuwa wakiomba pesa kutoka kwa wagombea kwa ajili ya kibali bandia. IEBC haitozi ada kwa fomu za kibali."
Ekegusii: "Abangainereria bagwekora buna abarigereria buna chikura chigoakwa babeire bagosangereria chibesa korwa ase baria bakorigia chikura kobarusia korwa erkodi yogokora bobe. Ekeombe keria gietenenerete buna chikura chiogoakwa (IEBC) nkeri gosaba chibesa erio korigereria gose nore namamocho aragotange toboria goakerwa chikura."

English: Engaging men and boys in prevention programs promotes healthy relationships and challenges harmful gender norms.
Kiswahili: Kuwashirikisha wanaume na wavulana katika programu za kuzuia maambukizi huendeleza mahusiano yenye afya na hupinga kanuni hatari za kijinsia.
Ekegusii: Renta abasacha nabura amo ase emeroberio yogosegeta oboamate obuya ase abanto na orokereria buna ogotareng'anana kwa banto ase engencho yebimira ere bobe.

English: The Kenya Police have specialized desks to handle child-related cases with sensitivity and confidentiality. Report cases at any police station.
Kiswahili: Polisi wa Kenya wana madawati maalum ya kushughulikia kesi zinazohusiana na watoto kwa unyeti na usiri. Ripoti kesi katika kituo chochote cha polisi.
Ekegusii: Chipori stesheni nchire negetengo kiabeen kegosugurikia buna abana bakomecherwa buna ogoakwa, ogotibongwa, obosomba, okoiba gose gokengania abana ase enchera chiobosani nabana na erendete obobisi bwabana. Karwe eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi.

English: Large birds prey on young livestock. Use scare devices and provide sheltered pens.
Kiswahili: Ndege wakubwa huwinda mifugo midogo. Tumia vifaa vya kutisha na uweke zizi zilizofunikwa.
Ekegusii: Ebibaki na makotu nigo akira ebichichu buna endagera yabo. Gitera etugoyao buya na rosia ebinto binga buna omonto obogoretie enyimbo gochia igoro na koyeka aroro kogosa ebinto ebio bitgete koira etugo.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre and the EU expanded campaigns to mobilize Kenyans against violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) amo nobomo bwa'Bongeresa (EU)mbagareetie chinkwana chiabo ase ogosegeta abanto ba Kenya korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.

English: Schools should conduct regular fire drills and have emergency plans for floods, fires, and conflicts.
Kiswahili: Shule zinapaswa kufanya mazoezi ya mara kwa mara ya kuzima moto na kuwa na mipango ya dharura kwa ajili ya mafuriko, moto, na migogoro.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ase chisukuru korenda ogwateka kwemerero ase chisukuru chiabo nomoroberio bwokwerenda igoro yetoigo,emerero,nechisegi.

English: US warns of road closures and heavy security in Nairobi CBD.
Kiswahili: Marekani yaonya kuhusu kufungwa kwa barabara na ulinzi mkali katika eneo la katikati mwa jiji la Nairobi.
Ekegusii: America yarure ogokurerwa igoro yogosiekwa chipara nobonge bwabasikari aaria etaoni gati ya Nairobi.

English: Training delivered to Anti Terrorism Police Unit officers to strengthen ideological awareness and operational skills under the national CVE framework.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yametolewa kwa maafisa wa Kitengo cha Polisi cha Kupambana na Ugaidi ili kuimarisha ufahamu wa kiitikadi na ujuzi wa uendeshaji chini ya mfumo wa kitaifa wa CVE.
Ekegusii: Amasomo arwetwe ase abasikari bari batenererete gotanga ogwateka gwechipomu gokongia chinhera chikomanya ebirengererio biogosari obongo na buna oranyare gotanga ayio goetera amachiko yokorwania gotanga gosarigwa obongo.

English: Local committees help coordinate rescue efforts and resource distribution during emergencies. Volunteer with your village committee.
Kiswahili: Kamati za mitaa husaidia kuratibu juhudi za uokoaji na usambazaji wa rasilimali wakati wa dharura. Jitolee na kamati ya kijiji chako.
Ekegusii: Chikomiti chi nka ase okomanyania na kobwaterana igoro yobokonyi na kobga obokonyi chinaki chiomobasekano.Erwe gokomora emeremo yokwerwa.

English: Follow travel advisories and avoid high-risk areas to ensure personal safety
Kiswahili: Fuata ushauri wa usafiri na epuka maeneo yenye hatari kubwa ili kuhakikisha usalama wa kibinafsi
Ekegusii: Bwatia amachiko nogosemigwa ase obotari na kabe are korwa ase aria aregire nechisagano goikerania oborendi bwao aye omonyene.

English: Leverage media platforms to expose corruption and protect public assets
Kiswahili: Tumia majukwaa ya vyombo vya habari kufichua ufisadi na kulinda mali za umma
Ekegusii: Abariki na komanyia amangana nere buya batumie ribaga riabo rigare nechinguru chiokomanyia gwasioria na korwania obokorekanu na korenda enobo yabainchi.

English: A bill proposes a 10‑year ban on corrupt firms from public tenders.
Ekegusii: Richiko riyia riatangire chikambani gose abanyabiasara abakorekanu gokora egasi neserikari ase emiaka 10 gotagora tenda ende.

English: Keep a first aid kit at home and learn basic first aid procedures.
Kiswahili: Weka vifaa vya huduma ya kwanza nyumbani na ujifunze taratibu za msingi za huduma ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Kabe namariogo nyomba aria aragokonye gokonyera oborwaire bwa mobasekano gose omonto oumiire otaramoikia nyagitari.

English: "We urge wananchi to report any person asking for 'expedited NHIF services' in exchange for cash. NHIF does not charge for processing."
Kiswahili: "Tunawasihi wananchi kumripoti mtu yeyote anayeomba 'huduma za NHIF za haraka' badala ya pesa taslimu. NHIF haitozi malipo kwa ajili ya usindikaji."
Ekegusii: Nigo togosaba abanto komanyia abagambi gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagosaba chibesa basuguikie akadi yao ya NHIF ekore egasi. NHIF teri gosaba besa goetia emesigo.

English: Certain plants poison livestock. Farmers should remove toxic plants and provide alternative fodder during drought. Veterinary analysis supports diagnosis.
Kiswahili: Mimea fulani huwa na sumu kwa mifugo. Wakulima wanapaswa kuondoa mimea yenye sumu na kutoa chakula mbadala wakati wa ukame. Uchambuzi wa mifugo unasaidia utambuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekero etugo yarire emete gete nigo ekoba esumu mebere yabo. Nere buya abaremi batogore emete buna eyio yonsi na koa chitugo chiabo obonyansi obuya chinaki chiguragura. Ogopima etugo yao nomonyagitari bwetugo nabio bikoenekia ayio.

English: UNODC and Kenya partnership to enhance legal frameworks and build investigative capacity against terrorism.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobomo bwechinse chiria chikwegambera korwania amariogo agotindia (UNODC) goetera okobwaterana na Kenya mbabwateranete goikerania amachiko yokorwania obokebago na gokinia chinguru chiobotuki bwobokebago bwokoruta chipomu.

English: A terror cell in Lamu was dismantled and suspects arrested in a joint security operation.
Kiswahili: Kikosi cha ugaidi huko Lamu kilivunjwa na washukiwa walikamatwa katika operesheni ya pamoja ya usalama.
Ekegusii: Eseri ase ebibago biechipomu bibekire aaria Lamu yabunetwe na abakagerwa mbabwatetwe goetera ebitengo ao ao bieserikari.

English: "We urge Kenyans to double-check the legitimacy of any NGO requesting donations via mobile payment. Many have been flagged for fraud."
Kiswahili: "Tunawahimiza Wakenya kuangalia upya uhalali wa shirika lolote lisilo la kiserikali linaloomba michango kupitia malipo ya simu. Mengi yametajwa kwa ulaghai."
Ekegusii: "Nigo togosaba abakenya koirorera gocheki oboamaene bwebiombe bia NGO dchigosaba ogokonya goetera entaneti. Chinyinge chiechio chianyorirwe koba echioboibi"

English: Australia urges extreme caution due to crime and terrorism.
Kiswahili: Australia yatoa wito wa tahadhari kali kutokana na uhalifu na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Australia yaboriruie koba maiso kegima ase engencho yobosaria bwokoruta chipomu.

English: Educate on bail and bond rights.
Kiswahili: Kuelimisha kuhusu dhamana na haki za dhamana.
Ekegusii: manyia abanto igoro yokobeka ebondi na oboronge bwomonto kobeka ebondi.

English: US warns of security force deployments; avoid protest zones.
Kiswahili: Marekani yaonya kuhusu kupelekwa kwa vikosi vya usalama; epuka maeneo ya maandamano.
Ekegusii: America yarure ogokurerwa igoro yogotoma basikari; kabe are korwa chinsemo chiria abanto bakorobererekana.
